name: Role Entry and Sign-In
description: A visitor picks their role on the landing page, then signs in with an instant synthetic demo account or their own credentials.

steps.description: Visitor opens the landing page and picks a role (Donor, NGO, Volunteer, Admin or CSR Sponsor).

business_rules.name: role_pick_signs_in_synthetic_demo_user
business_rules.description: Picking one of the five roles (Donor, NGO, Volunteer, Admin, CSR Sponsor) signs the visitor in as the pre-seeded synthetic demo User for that role, with no password or sign-up.
triggers: Visitor taps a role card on the landing page
side_effects: A session is started for the matching synthetic demo User
The visitor is routed to the home screen for that role
error_handling: If the demo User for the chosen role is missing or inactive, the visitor sees a message that the demo is unavailable and is offered the Login page instead
If the role is not one of the five listed roles, nothing is signed in and the visitor stays on the landing page

business_rules.name: demo_users_are_preapproved
business_rules.description: Demo User accounts are always in the approved state (pending → approved, never pending or suspended), so they can act immediately after role entry.
triggers: Visitor picks a role and a demo session starts
side_effects: The demo User is treated as an approved participant for permission checks on every screen
error_handling: If a demo User is found suspended, it is reset to approved before the session starts, and the admin is not notified because this is a synthetic account

business_rules.name: role_entry_collects_no_personal_data
business_rules.description: The role entry step stores no records and asks for no personal details; all demo identities are synthetic, so no real name, email or contact data is entered here.
triggers: Visitor loads the landing page or picks a role
side_effects: No new User, Restaurant, Ngo or other record is created by this step
error_handling: If any real-looking personal input is attempted through this step, it is not accepted; this screen only accepts the role choice

validation_rules.description: A role must be chosen before the visitor can enter the app.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a role to continue.

validation_rules.description: The chosen role must be one of Donor, NGO, Volunteer, Admin or CSR Sponsor.
validation_rules.error_message: That role is not available. Please choose Donor, NGO, Volunteer, Admin or CSR Sponsor.

steps.description: Visitor chooses the demo account option or the sign-in link for the selected role.

business_rules.name: demo_account_sign_in_is_instant_for_selected_role
business_rules.description: A visitor who chooses a role's demo option is signed in immediately as the synthetic demo User for that role, with no password or email verification.
triggers: Visitor taps the demo account option under a selected role on the Role Entry page
side_effects: A session is started for the synthetic demo User matching the chosen role
The visitor is taken to that role's home screen (Donor Dashboard, NGO Feed, Volunteer Tasks, Admin Operations or Sponsor Impact)
No email is sent and no Resend message is triggered by demo sign-in
error_handling: If the demo User for the chosen role is missing or not approved, the visitor stays on Role Entry and sees a message that the demo account is unavailable
If the role value is not one of the five defined roles, the request is rejected and no session is started

business_rules.name: demo_users_are_synthetic_and_pre_approved
business_rules.description: Demo Users are seeded as synthetic, pre-approved participants (status 'approved') so they can sign in and use their role without waiting for admin approval.
triggers: Visitor selects a role's demo option
Application is seeded with demo data before the pilot
side_effects: Only demo Users carry is_demo set to true, and they are shown as synthetic in the interface
Demo Users can reach their role's pages without an admin approval step
error_handling: If a demo User is found with status 'pending' or 'suspended', sign-in via the demo option is blocked and the visitor is told the demo account is not active

business_rules.name: sign_in_link_routes_to_login_with_role_context
business_rules.description: Choosing the sign-in link for a selected role takes the visitor to Login without creating a session, carrying the chosen role so the Login page can show it.
triggers: Visitor taps the sign-in link for the selected role on the Role Entry page
side_effects: Visitor is taken to the Login page with the chosen role shown
No User record is created or changed
error_handling: If the role value is not valid, the visitor stays on Role Entry and the sign-in link is not followed

business_rules.name: suspended_or_pending_users_cannot_start_a_session
business_rules.description: A User whose status is 'pending' or 'suspended' cannot start a session through either the demo option or the sign-in path that follows Role Entry.
triggers: Visitor attempts demo sign-in for a role
Visitor follows the sign-in link and submits credentials on Login
side_effects: No session is created for a pending or suspended User
Pending Users are told their account awaits admin approval; suspended Users are told their account is suspended
error_handling: Pending status shows 'Your account is awaiting admin approval'
Suspended status shows 'This account has been suspended. Contact the platform admin'

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected from Donor, NGO, Volunteer, Admin or Sponsor before a demo or sign-in option is available.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose a role to continue.

steps.description: Participant enters email and password on the login form and submits; the session is created and the role-specific home is shown.

business_rules.name: only_approved_users_can_sign_in
business_rules.description: A participant may start a session only when User.status is approved; accounts in pending_approval or suspended status are refused, so admin approval gates access.
triggers: Participant submits the login form with email and password
side_effects: A session is created only for approved users
Users in pending_approval or suspended status stay signed out and see a message explaining their status
error_handling: User.status is pending_approval: show that the account is awaiting admin approval and do not create a session
User.status is suspended: show that the account is suspended and do not create a session
Account is approved but the password does not match: treat as invalid credentials and do not create a session

business_rules.name: credentials_must_match_stored_user
business_rules.description: The submitted email is matched case-insensitively to one User.email, and the submitted password is checked against User.password_hash; a match is required before any session is created.
triggers: Participant submits the login form with email and password
side_effects: On success the matched User record is loaded for the session
On failure no session is created and no record is changed
error_handling: No User matches the email: show a generic invalid email or password message without revealing whether the account exists
Password does not match the stored hash: show the same generic invalid email or password message
Submission is empty or malformed: prompt the user to correct the form before any lookup occurs

business_rules.name: session_carries_user_role
business_rules.description: On successful sign-in the session records the User.id and User.role, and every later role-restricted page is checked against that role on the server.
triggers: Participant's credentials are verified and the account is approved
side_effects: A session is created containing User.id and User.role
Role-restricted pages and actions rely on this session role for permission checks
error_handling: User.role is missing or not one of donor, ngo, volunteer, admin or sponsor: refuse the session and show a support message rather than guessing a role

business_rules.name: sign_in_redirects_to_role_home
business_rules.description: After a session is created the participant is taken to the home screen for their User.role: donor to Donor Dashboard, ngo to NGO Feed, volunteer to Volunteer Tasks, admin to Admin Operations, and sponsor to Sponsor Impact.
triggers: A session is successfully created for an approved user
side_effects: The participant lands on the role-specific home screen instead of a generic page
error_handling: Role has no mapped home: send the participant to Role Entry with a message that their role home is unavailable

business_rules.name: login_email_case_insensitive_match
business_rules.description: Email addresses are compared after trimming surrounding whitespace and lowercasing, so User.email matches regardless of how the participant typed it.
triggers: Participant submits the login form with email and password
side_effects: Participants who type their email in a different case or with extra spaces still sign in to their account
error_handling: Normalised email still matches no User: show the generic invalid email or password message

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must be in a valid address format (local part, @, domain).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password.

steps.description: Shared email and password form renders and validates input for the login submission.

business_rules.name: only_approved_users_can_sign_in
business_rules.description: A User may sign in only when their approval status is approved; accounts in pending approval or suspended cannot start a session (pending → approved → suspended, with suspended users blocked from sign-in).
triggers: Participant submits the shared email and password form on Login
Participant submits the shared email and password form from Role Entry after choosing a role
side_effects: If User.status is approved, a session is created for that User and they are sent to their role's home page
If User.status is pending, sign-in is refused and the person is told their account awaits admin approval
If User.status is suspended, sign-in is refused and the person is told their account is suspended and to contact an admin
error_handling: Pending account: refuse sign-in and show that approval is still awaited, without creating a session
Suspended account: refuse sign-in and show the suspension message, without creating a session
Unknown email or wrong password: refuse sign-in with one generic credentials message that does not reveal which part was wrong

business_rules.name: credentials_must_match_a_user_record
business_rules.description: The submitted email must match an existing User.email and the submitted password must verify against that User's stored password before any session is granted.
triggers: Participant submits the shared email and password form on Login
side_effects: On a match, the User is identified as the signed-in participant for the session
On a mismatch, no User is signed in and no account details are disclosed
error_handling: No matching email or password mismatch: show the generic invalid credentials message and keep the typed email in the form
Account lookup unavailable: show a retry message and do not sign in

business_rules.name: sign_in_routes_user_by_role
business_rules.description: After a successful sign-in, the User is sent to the home page for their User.role: donor to Donor Dashboard, NGO to NGO Feed, volunteer to Volunteer Tasks, admin to Admin Operations, and CSR sponsor to Sponsor Impact.
triggers: Approved User completes sign-in on the shared form
side_effects: The participant lands on the Donor Dashboard, NGO Feed, Volunteer Tasks, Admin Operations or Sponsor Impact page matching their role
The role-specific navigation for that session is shown
error_handling: User with no recognised role: refuse to route them to a role page and show a message asking them to contact an admin

business_rules.name: demo_accounts_are_synthetic_only
business_rules.description: Only synthetic demo Users, seeded for the hackathon, may be signed into from the instant demo entry, and their credentials are not real personal data.
triggers: Visitor picks a role on Role Entry and uses the instant synthetic demo account
side_effects: The demo User is signed in through the same shared sign-in path as other participants
The session is marked as a synthetic demo session
error_handling: Demo account missing or not approved: show that the demo is unavailable and offer the manual email and password form

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your email address to sign in.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address (local part, @, domain with a dot).
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.error_message: Password must be 128 characters or fewer.

name: Account Sign-Up with Admin Approval
description: A donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor creates an account that stays pending until an admin approves it.

steps.description: Prospective participant opens the sign-up page and selects their participant type.

business_rules.name: participant_type_must_be_one_of_four_roles
business_rules.description: A prospective participant must select exactly one of the four participant types (donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor) before the account can be created, and that choice sets the role on the new User.
triggers: Prospective participant selects a participant type on the sign-up page
side_effects: The selected type is carried forward and becomes User.role when the account is created
The participant sees the account details form for the chosen type
error_handling: No type selected: the participant cannot continue and is asked to choose one
A type outside donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor is rejected and no account is started

business_rules.name: new_account_starts_pending_admin_approval
business_rules.description: Every newly signed-up account starts as pending and cannot act in the app until an admin approves it (pending → approved, or pending → suspended if rejected, with approved → suspended possible later).
triggers: Participant completes sign-up after selecting a participant type
Admin approves or suspends the account from Admin Operations
side_effects: User.approval_status is set to pending at creation
The participant is told their account is awaiting admin approval
The admin is shown the new pending account for review
error_handling: A pending or suspended participant who tries to sign in is shown that their account is not yet approved
An approval or suspension action on an account already in the target state is ignored with no change

validation_rules.description: A participant type must be selected from donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor before continuing.
validation_rules.error_message: Please select whether you are a donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor to continue.

steps.description: Participant enters organisation or personal details, email and password through the shared form.

business_rules.name: new_signup_creates_pending_user
business_rules.description: A participant who completes the sign-up form gets a User record in the pending state (pending → approved or suspended), and cannot access role features until an admin approves it.
triggers: Participant submits the sign-up form with organisation or personal details, email and password
side_effects: User.status is set to pending
User.role is set to the role the participant chose (donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor)
User.password_hash stores a salted hash of the password, never the plain password
The participant is shown a message that the account is awaiting admin approval
No session is started, so the participant cannot sign in until approved
error_handling: If the email already belongs to an existing User, no new record is created and the participant sees that the email is already registered
If the submission fails validation, no User record is created and the form keeps the entered values except the password

business_rules.name: email_must_be_unique_across_users
business_rules.description: Each User.email is unique and compared case-insensitively, so one email maps to one account.
triggers: Participant submits the sign-up form with an email address
side_effects: The email is stored in lowercase so later sign-in and password reset find the same account
error_handling: If the email matches an existing User, the sign-up is rejected and the participant is told to sign in or reset their password instead

business_rules.name: password_must_meet_minimum_policy
business_rules.description: A password must be at least 8 characters and contain a letter and a digit before it is hashed into User.password_hash.
triggers: Participant submits the sign-up form with a password
side_effects: Only the hash of an accepted password is persisted
error_handling: A password that is too short or lacks a letter or digit is rejected with the policy stated next to the field

business_rules.name: signup_role_must_be_a_permitted_participant_role
business_rules.description: The role chosen at sign-up must be one of donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor; admin accounts cannot be self-registered.
triggers: Participant selects a role on the sign-up form
side_effects: User.role is set to the permitted value and the account enters the approval queue for that role
error_handling: A submitted role of admin, or any unknown value, is rejected server-side and no User record is created

validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your organisation name (up to 120 characters).

validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a valid email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must not already be registered to another User, compared case-insensitively.
validation_rules.error_message: This email is already registered. Sign in or reset your password.

validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a password.

validation_rules.description: Password must be at least 8 and at most 72 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must be between 8 and 72 characters.

validation_rules.description: Password must contain at least one letter and one digit.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must include at least one letter and one number.

validation_rules.description: A role must be selected from donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose how you will use Anna Mitra.

steps.description: Account is created in pending state and the participant sees a message that admin approval is required.

business_rules.name: new_account_starts_pending
business_rules.description: Every self-registered account is created in the pending state (pending → active after admin approval) and cannot take any participant action until an admin approves it.
triggers: Participant submits the sign-up form on the Sign Up page
side_effects: A User record is created with User.status set to pending
No signed-in session is started for the new user
The participant sees a message that admin approval is required before they can sign in
error_handling: If the User record cannot be saved, no account is created and the participant sees a general error asking them to try again
If the user submits the form twice, the second submission is rejected because the email already exists

business_rules.name: pending_user_cannot_sign_in_or_act
business_rules.description: A User with status pending is refused sign-in and receives the approval-required message instead of a session, and server-side checks block any action by pending users.
triggers: Pending participant attempts to sign in after signing up
Pending participant attempts to use any participant screen
side_effects: No session is created for the pending user
The pending user is shown a message that admin approval is still required
error_handling: A suspended user is shown a distinct message that the account has been suspended and to contact the admin
Requests from pending users to participant endpoints are rejected even if a stale session token exists

business_rules.name: one_account_per_email
business_rules.description: Each email address can belong to only one User account, regardless of the role chosen at sign-up.
triggers: Participant submits the sign-up form with an email already registered
side_effects: No new User record is created
Existing account is left unchanged
error_handling: The participant is told that an account with this email already exists and is directed to sign in or reset their password

business_rules.name: role_selected_at_sign_up_is_pending_role
business_rules.description: The role chosen at sign-up (donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor) is stored on the User as a requested role that takes effect only when an admin approves the account.
triggers: Participant selects a role and submits the sign-up form
side_effects: User.role is stored as selected
The role's dashboard becomes reachable only after User.status becomes active
error_handling: If no role is provided or the role is not one of the four allowed values, the account is not created

name: Password Recovery by Email
description: A participant requests a reset link by email and sets a new password from the emailed link.

steps.description: Participant opens the forgot-password page and enters the email address on their account.

business_rules.name: reset_request_gives_same_response_for_any_email
business_rules.description: The forgot-password request always shows the same confirmation message whether or not the entered email belongs to an account, so the page cannot be used to discover which emails are registered.
triggers: Participant submits an email address on the Forgot Password page
side_effects: The participant sees a generic message saying that a reset link will be sent if the address matches an account
No information about account existence is shown on the page
error_handling: Email matches no account: show the same generic confirmation and send nothing
Email matches a suspended or unapproved account: show the same generic confirmation and send nothing
Submission fails on the server: show a retry message and do not reveal account state

business_rules.name: reset_link_issued_only_for_approved_active_accounts
business_rules.description: For a matching email, a single-use password reset token is generated and stored on the User, with an expiry time, only when the account is approved and not suspended (pending → approved → active, or suspended blocks reset).
triggers: Participant submits an email address that matches an existing User record
side_effects: User.password_reset_token_hash is set to a hash of a newly generated token
User.password_reset_expires_at is set to a short configured expiry from now
Any previously issued unused reset token for that User is invalidated
The participant receives a password reset email containing a link to the Reset Password page
error_handling: Account is pending admin approval: no token issued and no email sent; generic confirmation is shown
Account is suspended: no token issued and no email sent; generic confirmation is shown
Resend delivery fails: the token is still stored, the failure is logged, and the participant sees the generic confirmation

business_rules.name: reset_email_sent_through_resend
business_rules.description: The password reset email is sent via Resend and contains only the reset link and an expiry notice, never the password or the token in plain logs.
triggers: A reset token is issued for an eligible User
side_effects: The User receives an email from Resend with the reset link and the time it expires
The delivery attempt is recorded for support without storing the raw token
error_handling: Resend API unavailable: retry is not automatic in the request; the participant can resubmit the form, which issues a fresh token

validation_rules.description: Email address is required to request a password reset.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter the email address on your account.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address (local part, @ sign, domain with a dot) and no longer than 254 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

steps.description: System sends a reset link by email; the participant sees a confirmation that the email was sent.

business_rules.name: reset_link_issued_only_for_registered_email
business_rules.description: When a participant submits an email on the forgot-password form and it matches an existing User.email, the system issues a single-use reset token for that User and emails the reset link through Resend; no token is issued for unknown addresses.
triggers: Participant submits the forgot-password form with an email address
side_effects: User.password_reset_token_hash is set to a hash of the new single-use token
User.password_reset_expires_at is set to the configured reset window from now
User.password_reset_requested_at is set to the current time
The matching user is emailed a reset link via Resend
error_handling: Email matches no User: no token is created and no email is sent, but the confirmation is still shown

Email delivery through Resend fails: the failure is logged, the stored token is cleared so the user is not left with an unusable token, and the confirmation is still shown without revealing the failure

business_rules.name: confirmation_shown_regardless_of_account_existence
business_rules.description: After any submitted email, the participant sees the same confirmation that a reset email was sent if the account exists, so the form does not reveal which emails are registered.
triggers: Participant submits the forgot-password form with any well-formed email address
side_effects: The participant sees an identical confirmation message whether or not a User matched the email
error_handling: Malformed email is rejected by field validation before any lookup, so no confirmation is shown for it

business_rules.name: new_reset_request_invalidates_previous_token
business_rules.description: Each new reset request for a User replaces the previously stored reset token, so only the most recently emailed link can be used.
triggers: A reset request is submitted for an email whose User already has an outstanding reset token
side_effects: Earlier reset links for that User stop working
User.password_reset_token_hash and User.password_reset_expires_at are overwritten with the new token details
error_handling: Earlier link is used after a newer request: the reset step rejects it as invalid or superseded

business_rules.name: reset_token_stored_only_as_hash
business_rules.description: The reset token is generated server-side and only a hash is persisted on the User, while the raw token exists only in the emailed link.
triggers: A reset token is generated during a password recovery request
side_effects: The raw token is never written to the database or logs
The emailed link carries the raw token for the reset step to verify against the stored hash
error_handling: Database write of the hash fails: no email is sent and the confirmation is still shown

validation_rules.description: The email address field must not be empty before the recovery request is submitted.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the email address for your account.

validation_rules.description: The email must be a well-formed address (local part, @, domain with a dot) and no longer than 254 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

steps.description: Participant opens the emailed link and enters a new password using the token from the link.

business_rules.name: reset_token_must_be_valid_unexpired_and_unused
business_rules.description: A new password is set only when the token from the emailed link matches the stored reset token for that User, has not expired, and has not already been used.
triggers: Participant opens the reset link from their email and submits a new password
Participant resubmits the form with the same token after a successful reset
side_effects: User.password_reset_used_at is set to the current time when the reset succeeds, so the same link cannot be used again
The participant is shown a clear message that the link is invalid or expired and is directed to request a new reset
error_handling: Token is missing, malformed or does not match any User: reject with a generic 'link is invalid or has expired' message and change nothing
Token has passed User.password_reset_expires_at: reject, leave the stored password unchanged, and offer a route back to Forgot Password
Token has already been used (User.password_reset_used_at is set): reject with the same invalid-link message

business_rules.name: reset_password_stores_only_a_hash_and_invalidates_the_token
business_rules.description: On a successful reset the new password is stored only as User.password_hash, and the reset token is cleared so it cannot be used again.
triggers: Participant submits a valid token with a password that passes validation
side_effects: User.password_hash is replaced with a hash of the new password
User.password_reset_token_hash and User.password_reset_expires_at are cleared
Participant is told the password was changed and can sign in with the new password
error_handling: Database write fails while replacing the hash: the reset is not marked used, the old password remains valid, and the participant sees a retry message
Plain-text password is never written to any field or log

business_rules.name: suspended_accounts_cannot_reset_password
business_rules.description: Only a User whose account_status is approved may set a new password; pending or suspended accounts are refused even with a valid token.
triggers: Participant submits a valid reset token for an account that an admin has suspended or not yet approved
side_effects: No change to User.password_hash for the refused account
Participant sees a message that the account cannot be reset and should contact an admin
error_handling: Account status is suspended: refuse the reset without revealing internal reasons beyond the contact-admin message
Account status is pending approval: refuse the reset and explain that the account is awaiting approval

validation_rules.description: A new password must be entered before the form can be submitted.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a new password.

validation_rules.description: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must be at least 8 characters.

validation_rules.description: The password must be re-entered in the confirmation field.
validation_rules.error_message: Please confirm your new password.

validation_rules.description: The confirmation value must exactly match the new password.
validation_rules.error_message: Passwords do not match.

steps.description: Participant returns to sign-in with the new password accepted.

business_rules.name: new_password_must_replace_old_password_for_sign_in
business_rules.description: After a successful reset, the User's new password is the only password accepted at sign-in, and the old password is rejected (old password → new password).
triggers: Participant submits the sign-in form with the email and new password set during the reset flow
Participant submits the sign-in form with the previous password after a reset
side_effects: Participant is signed in and taken to their role's home screen when the new password matches
Sign-in is refused with the same generic message when the old password is used
error_handling: Wrong password: show a generic 'Email or password is incorrect' message without revealing which field failed
Unknown email: show the same generic message so account existence is not disclosed

business_rules.name: reset_password_hash_must_be_single_use
business_rules.description: Once the new password is saved, the reset token is cleared from the User record so the emailed link cannot set a password again (reset token active → consumed).
triggers: Participant's new password is saved during the reset flow and they arrive at sign-in
side_effects: User.password_reset_token_hash and User.password_reset_expires_at are cleared
The emailed reset link stops working for this User
error_handling: Reset link opened again after use: the reset screen shows that the link is no longer valid and offers to request a new one
Reset link past expiry: the link is rejected and a new reset can be requested from Forgot Password

business_rules.name: only_approved_users_may_sign_in_after_reset
business_rules.description: Signing in with the new password succeeds only when the User's approval status is approved, so suspended or pending participants are turned away even after resetting (pending → approved, or suspended blocks sign-in).
triggers: Participant submits the sign-in form with the new password
Admin suspends a participant whose password was recently reset
side_effects: Approved users receive a session and are redirected to their role's home screen
Pending or suspended users see a message explaining their account is awaiting approval or has been suspended, and no session is created
error_handling: Approval status is pending: show 'Your account is awaiting admin approval' and do not create a session
Approval status is suspended: show 'This account is suspended. Contact the admin' and do not create a session

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in and must not be blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the email address you signed up with.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address with a local part, an @ sign and a domain containing a dot.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required at sign-in and must not be blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password.

validation_rules.description: Password input is accepted up to the maximum length allowed when the password was set, and is compared against the stored hash without trimming.
validation_rules.error_message: Password is too long. Check that you entered the correct password.

name: Donor Posts Surplus Food
description: A donor posts surplus food in under 60 seconds, either by one-tap repeat, by voice or text with AI extraction, or manually, then completes the handling checklist and publishes.

steps.description: Donor opens the dashboard, sees recent activity and taps a repeat donation or starts a new post.

business_rules.name: only_approved_restaurant_donors_can_start_posts
business_rules.description: A donor can start a new post or repeat donation only when the restaurant is approved (pending → approved → suspended, with suspension blocking new posts).
triggers: Donor opens the donor dashboard
Donor taps 'repeat donation' or 'start new post'
side_effects: Dashboard shows the new-post and repeat actions only for an approved restaurant
A pending or suspended restaurant sees a notice that posting is unavailable until admin approval, and no Donation draft is created
error_handling: User has no linked restaurant: show a message to complete sign-up and block posting
Restaurant is pending approval: show 'awaiting admin approval' and disable actions
Restaurant is suspended: show 'posting suspended, contact admin' and disable actions

business_rules.name: repeat_donation_prefills_from_previous_donation_only
business_rules.description: Tapping repeat donation creates a new draft Donation that copies the food description, portions and pickup window from the chosen prior Donation, linked through repeated_from_donation_id, while leaving the draft's status as draft.
triggers: Donor taps 'repeat donation' on a recent donation in the dashboard activity list
side_effects: A new Donation record is created in draft status with the copied values, ready for the donor to edit in Quick Post
The source Donation is left unchanged
StatusEvent records the new donation's draft creation
error_handling: Source donation belongs to another restaurant: reject and show 'donation not found'
Source donation no longer exists: show 'this donation can no longer be repeated' and offer a fresh post

business_rules.name: safety_declarations_are_never_reused_on_repeat
business_rules.description: A repeat donation copies restaurant preferences but never copies the prior HandlingDeclaration, so the donor must complete a fresh handling checklist (preparation time, storage/handling, allergens) for every new Donation.
triggers: Donor creates a repeat donation draft
Donor opens the handling checklist on a repeat draft
side_effects: The new draft has no HandlingDeclaration until the donor completes the checklist
RestaurantPreference values are applied to the draft, but no safety fields are carried over
Donation cannot move beyond draft until a fresh HandlingDeclaration is saved
error_handling: Donor tries to publish a repeat draft without a fresh handling checklist: block publishing and prompt for the checklist
Stored RestaurantPreference is missing: start with empty preferences and continue

business_rules.name: dashboard_activity_reflects_latest_donation_status
business_rules.description: The dashboard lists the restaurant's recent donations ordered by creation time, each showing its current status derived from the latest StatusEvent (draft → published → claimed → collected → delivered, or cancelled/expired).
triggers: Donor opens the donor dashboard
Donor returns to the dashboard after a status change
side_effects: Dashboard shows the donor's recent donations with their current status
Donations from other restaurants are never shown
error_handling: No donations yet: show an empty state with a 'start a new post' action
Status history is missing for a donation: show the donation's stored status and log the gap

steps.description: Donor describes the food by voice or typing; AI extracts the food description, portions and pickup-by time, or the donor enters them manually if AI or voice is unavailable.

business_rules.name: ai_extraction_fills_donation_fields_with_manual_fallback
business_rules.description: The donor's spoken or typed food description is sent to the AI provider, which fills the food description, portions and pickup-by time; when AI or voice is unavailable, the donor enters these three values manually.
triggers: Donor submits a voice recording or typed text describing the surplus food
Donor selects manual entry or the AI provider or microphone is unavailable
side_effects: Donation.food_description, Donation.portions and Donation.pickup_by_at are pre-filled with the AI-extracted values
Donation.input_method records voice, text or manual
Donation.ai_extracted is set true only when the AI provider supplied the values
The donor is shown the manual form with the three fields when extraction is unavailable or fails
error_handling: AI provider not configured or unreachable: the donor is switched to manual entry with a notice that AI extraction is unavailable
AI returns no portions or no pickup time: those fields are left blank for the donor to fill in
Microphone permission denied or not supported: the donor is offered typed input
AI returns values the donor cannot accept: the donor edits them before anything is saved

business_rules.name: extracted_values_must_be_confirmed_by_donor
business_rules.description: AI-extracted food description, portions and pickup-by time remain editable and are not treated as final until the donor accepts them on this step.
triggers: AI extraction completes and populates the form
Donor edits any extracted field
side_effects: Donation.status stays draft until the donor moves on from this step
Edited values overwrite the AI-extracted values on the Donation record
error_handling: Donor leaves the step without accepting values: the Donation remains a draft and nothing is published
Extraction result is clearly empty or ambiguous: the donor must fill the fields manually before continuing

business_rules.name: pickup_by_time_must_be_in_future
business_rules.description: The pickup-by time must be later than the current time, so no donation is posted with a deadline that has already passed.
triggers: Donor enters or accepts a pickup-by time
Donor continues from this step
side_effects: Donation.pickup_by_at is stored only when it is in the future
The donation is kept as a draft until the pickup deadline is valid
error_handling: Pickup-by time is in the past: the donor is asked to choose a later time
Pickup-by time missing: the donor cannot continue until it is set

business_rules.name: portions_must_be_positive_whole_number
business_rules.description: The number of portions is a whole number of at least 1 and is the quantity that later claims are allocated against.
triggers: Donor enters or accepts a portion count
AI extraction populates the portion count
side_effects: Donation.portions is stored as the total quantity available for claiming
The estimated waste avoided for this donation is derived from Donation.portions
error_handling: Portions is zero, negative, fractional or non-numeric: the donor is asked to enter a whole number of portions
AI extracts an implausible count: the donor must confirm or correct it before continuing

business_rules.name: food_description_required_before_continuing
business_rules.description: A food description must be present, whether typed, transcribed or extracted, before the donor can continue to the handling checklist.
triggers: Donor attempts to continue from this step
Voice transcription or AI extraction returns an empty description
side_effects: Donation.food_description is stored with the donation draft
error_handling: Description empty: the donor is prompted to describe the food by voice, typing or manual entry

validation_rules.description: The food description is required and must not be blank.
validation_rules.error_message: Please describe the surplus food.

validation_rules.description: The food description is between 3 and 500 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Food description must be between 3 and 500 characters.

validation_rules.description: The number of portions is required.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter how many portions are available.

validation_rules.description: Portions is a whole number of at least 1.
validation_rules.error_message: Portions must be a whole number of at least 1.

validation_rules.description: The pickup-by time is required.
validation_rules.error_message: Please choose a pickup-by time.

validation_rules.description: The pickup-by time must be later than the current time.
validation_rules.error_message: Pickup-by time must be in the future.

steps.description: Donor edits the extracted values, such as portions and pickup-by time, before publishing.

business_rules.name: donation_values_editable_only_before_publish
business_rules.description: A donor may change a donation's food description, portions and pickup-by time only while it is a draft (draft → published); once published, these values are locked.
triggers: Donor changes food description, portions or pickup-by time on the Quick Post form before tapping publish
Donor attempts to edit values on a donation that has already been published
side_effects: Donation.food_description, Donation.portions and Donation.pickup_by are saved with the donor's edited values
Donation.updated_at is refreshed on each save
A published donation's values are not changed by any later edit attempt
error_handling: If the donation is no longer a draft, the save is rejected and the donor is told the donation is already published and can no longer be edited
If the donation belongs to another restaurant, the save is rejected as not permitted

business_rules.name: donor_edits_override_extracted_values
business_rules.description: Values the donor edits replace the values extracted from voice or typing, and the donor's confirmed values are what gets published (extracted → edited → published).
triggers: Donor corrects an extracted food description, portion count or pickup-by time
Donor accepts extracted values without changes
side_effects: Donation.food_description, Donation.portions and Donation.pickup_by hold the donor's final values
Donation.input_source records whether the values came from voice, typing or manual entry
error_handling: If the extraction returned no usable value for a field, the field is left blank and the donor must fill it in before publishing
If the extraction service is unavailable, the donor proceeds with manual entry of all fields

business_rules.name: pickup_by_must_be_in_future
business_rules.description: The pickup-by time must be later than the current time when the donation is published, enforced on the server as well as the form.
triggers: Donor sets or edits the pickup-by time
Donor taps publish with a pickup-by time that has already passed
side_effects: The donation is not moved from draft to published while the pickup-by time is in the past
Donation.pickup_by is stored only when it is a valid future time
error_handling: If the pickup-by time is in the past, publishing is blocked and the donor is asked to set a later time
If the server clock and the device clock disagree, the server's time is used for the check

business_rules.name: portions_must_be_positive_whole_number_within_limit
business_rules.description: Portions must be a whole number of at least 1 and no more than the configured maximum per donation, enforced on the server.
triggers: Donor sets or edits the portion count
Donor publishes a donation with a portion count outside the allowed range
side_effects: Donation.portions is stored as a whole number that NGOs can claim against
Donation.portions becomes the total quantity available for claims once published
error_handling: If portions is zero, negative, fractional or blank, the save is rejected and the donor is asked for a whole number of portions
If portions exceeds the configured maximum, the save is rejected and the donor is shown the limit

business_rules.name: donation_requires_description_and_portions_to_publish
business_rules.description: A donation moves from draft to published only when it has a food description, a portion count and a pickup-by time.
triggers: Donor taps publish on the Quick Post form
side_effects: Donation.status becomes published
A StatusEvent is recorded for the draft → published transition
The donation becomes visible to matched NGOs
error_handling: If any required field is missing, publishing is blocked and each missing field is marked on the form
If the donation is already published, the publish request is ignored and the current status is shown

validation_rules.description: Food description is required and must contain at least 3 characters after trimming whitespace.
validation_rules.error_message: Describe the food so NGOs know what is being offered (at least 3 characters).

validation_rules.description: Food description may be at most 300 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Keep the food description under 300 characters.

validation_rules.description: Portions is a whole number from 1 up to the configured per-donation maximum.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions between 1 and the allowed maximum.

validation_rules.description: Pickup-by time must be a valid date and time later than the current moment.
validation_rules.error_message: Pick a pickup-by time that is later than now.

steps.description: Donor completes the fresh handling checklist covering preparation time, storage and handling, and allergens, and optionally adds a photo.

business_rules.name: handling_declaration_required_before_publish
business_rules.description: A Donation moves from draft → published only when its HandlingDeclaration is complete (preparation time, storage method, allergens and checklist confirmation all recorded).
triggers: Donor taps Publish on the Quick Post screen after completing the handling checklist
Donor submits the handling checklist for a donation
side_effects: HandlingDeclaration.completed_at is set when all required checklist items are valid
Donation.status becomes published only after the declaration is complete
a StatusEvent is recorded for the donation's move to published
NGOs in range see the donation in their feed only after it is published
error_handling: If any required checklist item is missing, publishing is blocked and the donor is shown which items remain
If the donor attempts to publish with an incomplete declaration, Donation.status stays draft and no StatusEvent is recorded
If the declaration save fails, the donation remains draft and the donor can retry without re-entering values

business_rules.name: safety_declarations_not_reused_from_preferences
business_rules.description: Each HandlingDeclaration belongs to exactly one Donation and starts blank; saved RestaurantPreference records never prefill preparation time, storage method, allergens or checklist confirmation.
triggers: Donor opens the handling checklist for a new post
Donor starts a repeat donation with one tap
Donor saves restaurant preferences
side_effects: a new HandlingDeclaration is created for each donation with empty safety fields
RestaurantPreference keeps only non-safety preferences
the donor must answer the checklist again for every donation, including repeats
error_handling: If a saved preference would supply a safety value, that value is ignored and the checklist starts empty
If a repeat donation is posted without a new checklist, publishing is blocked by handling_declaration_required_before_publish

business_rules.name: allergens_must_be_explicitly_answered
business_rules.description: HandlingDeclaration.allergens must hold an explicit answer, either a list of allergens present or an explicit 'none declared', so an unanswered allergen question never counts as safe.
triggers: Donor reaches the allergens section of the handling checklist
Donor submits the handling checklist
side_effects: HandlingDeclaration.allergens is stored with the explicit answer
the NGO sees the allergen declaration on the donation detail and feed match explanation
error_handling: If allergens is left unanswered, the checklist cannot be submitted and the donor is asked to pick an option
If the donor selects an allergen list with no items, it is treated as unanswered and the donor is asked to confirm

business_rules.name: preparation_time_cannot_be_in_future
business_rules.description: HandlingDeclaration.prepared_at must be on or before the current time and no earlier than the start of the day the surplus was made.
triggers: Donor enters the preparation time in the handling checklist
Donor submits the handling checklist
side_effects: HandlingDeclaration.prepared_at is stored and shown to NGOs as the preparation time
the donation's freshness window used for NGO match explanations is derived from prepared_at
error_handling: If prepared_at is in the future, the donor is told the preparation time cannot be later than now
If prepared_at is more than a day earlier than the current date, the donor is asked to confirm the date

business_rules.name: photo_is_optional_and_does_not_block_publishing
business_rules.description: HandlingDeclaration.photo_url is optional; when a valid photo is attached it is stored with the declaration, and when it is absent the declaration can still be completed.
triggers: Donor adds an optional photo to the handling checklist
Donor submits the handling checklist without a photo
side_effects: HandlingDeclaration.photo_url is stored and displayed on the Donation Detail screen
the donation can be published with or without a photo
error_handling: If the photo upload fails, the checklist values are kept and the donor can publish without a photo or retry the upload
If the photo is not an accepted image type or is too large, the upload is rejected and the donor is told why

business_rules.name: declaration_locked_once_claimed
business_rules.description: After an NGO has claimed any portion of a donation, its HandlingDeclaration can no longer be edited by the donor.
triggers: Donor attempts to edit the handling checklist after a Claim exists
An NGO places a Claim on the donation
side_effects: the declaration is shown as locked on the Donation Detail screen
any attempted change is recorded as a StatusEvent for the donation
error_handling: If the donor tries to edit a locked declaration, the change is rejected and the donor is told the NGO has already claimed it
If the donor needs to correct a safety detail after claim, the correction must be raised through admin resolution

validation_rules.description: Preparation time must be a date and time no later than now.
validation_rules.error_message: Preparation time can't be in the future. Enter when the food was prepared.

validation_rules.description: Storage and handling method must be chosen from the list of allowed storage options.
validation_rules.error_message: Select how the food was stored before pickup.

validation_rules.description: Allergens must be answered with either a list of allergens present or an explicit 'none declared' option.
validation_rules.error_message: Select the allergens present, or choose 'None declared', before submitting.

validation_rules.description: The donor must confirm that the handling checklist answers are accurate before submitting.
validation_rules.error_message: Confirm the checklist answers are accurate to continue.

validation_rules.description: If a photo is added, it must be a JPEG or PNG image no larger than 5 MB; the photo is optional.
validation_rules.error_message: Add a JPEG or PNG photo up to 5 MB, or skip this step.

steps.description: Donor publishes the donation, which becomes available to eligible NGOs, and sees it listed with its initial status.

business_rules.name: donation_publish_requires_complete_handling_declaration
business_rules.description: A donation moves from draft → published only when its handling declaration (preparation time, storage/handling and allergens) is complete.
triggers: Donor taps Publish on the Quick Post page
side_effects: Donation.status becomes published only if HandlingDeclaration.completed_at is set
Donation.published_at is recorded
error_handling: Handling declaration incomplete: publish is refused, Donation.status stays draft, and the donor is shown which checklist section is missing
No HandlingDeclaration exists for the donation: publish is refused and the donor is asked to complete the checklist

business_rules.name: donation_publish_requires_future_pickup_deadline_and_positive_portions
business_rules.description: A donation can be published only if its pickup-by time is still in the future and it has at least one portion.
triggers: Donor taps Publish on the Quick Post page
side_effects: Donation.status becomes published only when both checks pass
error_handling: Pickup-by time is in the past: publish is refused and the donor is asked to set a later pickup time
Portions total is zero or less: publish is refused and the donor is asked to enter a valid portion count

business_rules.name: donor_and_restaurant_must_be_approved_to_publish
business_rules.description: Only a donor whose User and Restaurant are both approved by an admin can publish a donation.
triggers: Donor taps Publish on the Quick Post page
side_effects: Donation.status becomes published only for approved participants
error_handling: User.approval_status is pending or suspended: publish is refused and the donor sees that the account is awaiting admin approval
Restaurant.approval_status is pending or suspended: publish is refused and the donor is told the restaurant is not active

business_rules.name: published_donation_becomes_visible_to_eligible_ngos
business_rules.description: Once published, a donation is offered only to approved NGOs that are currently available and whose need has not passed the donation's pickup-by time (draft → published).
triggers: Donation.status changes to published
side_effects: Donation appears in the NGO Feed of each eligible NGO
Eligible NGOs are sent an in-app alert and a push notification through OneSignal
error_handling: No eligible NGO is currently available: the donation stays published and is listed without alerts, and the donor sees that no NGO is available yet
Push notification delivery fails or OneSignal is not configured: the donation is still visible in the NGO Feed and the failure is recorded without blocking publish

business_rules.name: publish_status_change_is_recorded_as_status_event
business_rules.description: Each publish records a StatusEvent showing the change from draft to published, so the donation's history starts at publication.
triggers: Donation.status changes to published
side_effects: A StatusEvent is created with from_status draft and to_status published
The donor's Donation Detail and Tracking views show published as the initial status
error_handling: StatusEvent write fails: the status change is rolled back so the donation is never published without its history entry

business_rules.name: publish_is_idempotent_against_repeat_taps
business_rules.description: A donation that is already published is not published again, so repeated taps do not create duplicate StatusEvents or notifications.
triggers: Donor taps Publish more than once or retries after a slow response
side_effects: The existing published donation is returned to the donor unchanged
No second StatusEvent is created and NGOs are not re-notified
error_handling: Donation is already published: the request succeeds with no changes

validation_rules.description: The pickup-by time must be later than the current time when the donation is published.
validation_rules.error_message: Pickup-by time has passed. Please set a later time before publishing.

validation_rules.description: The number of portions must be a whole number of at least 1.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter at least 1 portion to publish this donation.

validation_rules.description: The handling checklist (preparation time, storage/handling and allergens) must be completed before publishing.
validation_rules.error_message: Complete the handling checklist before publishing.

name: Donor Tracks Donation Status
description: A donor reviews the status of each donation and opens one to see its handling declarations and status history.

steps.description: Donor opens the tracking list and sees each donation with its current status.

business_rules.name: donor_sees_only_own_restaurant_donations
business_rules.description: A donor sees only the donations posted by their own restaurant, never another restaurant's donations.
triggers: Donor opens the tracking list
Donor refreshes the tracking list
side_effects: The tracking list shows only donations whose restaurant matches the signed-in donor's restaurant
error_handling: If the donor has no restaurant linked to their account, the list is empty and the donor is told to complete their restaurant setup
If a donation belongs to another restaurant, it is excluded from the response rather than shown greyed out

business_rules.name: donation_status_shown_is_current_lifecycle_state
business_rules.description: Each donation is shown with its current status, which is the most recent state in its lifecycle, such as published, claimed, collected, handed over or confirmed.
triggers: Donor opens the tracking list
A status change occurs on a donation while the donor is viewing the list
side_effects: Each donation row displays the status from Donation.status, which reflects the latest StatusEvent recorded for it
The list reflects status changes made by NGOs, volunteers or admins on the next load
error_handling: If a donation has no status yet, it is shown as draft so the donor still sees the donation
If the status cannot be read, the row shows an 'unavailable' label and the rest of the list still loads

business_rules.name: expired_reservation_returns_donation_to_published
business_rules.description: When a claim's reservation window lapses without confirmation, its unconfirmed portions are released and the donation returns to published (published → claimed → published).
triggers: The configurable reservation timeout (default 5 minutes) elapses on an unconfirmed claim
Donor opens the tracking list after the timeout has passed
side_effects: Claim.status becomes expired
Donation.status returns from claimed to published and the released portions become available again
A StatusEvent is recorded for the donation's return to published
error_handling: If the release job fails, the donation still shows claimed and the release is retried on the next status read
If the claim was already confirmed before the timeout, no release occurs and the status stays as confirmed

business_rules.name: tracking_list_is_read_only_for_donor
business_rules.description: The donor can view donation status on the tracking list but cannot change any donation's status or details from this page.
triggers: Donor opens the tracking list
side_effects: No Donation or StatusEvent records are written when the list is viewed
error_handling: If a status-changing request is sent from this page, the server rejects it because status transitions are enforced server-side only through their owning actions

steps.description: Donor sees a summary card for each donation showing status and any match information.

business_rules.name: donation_card_status_reflects_latest_status_event
business_rules.description: A donation's displayed status is taken from its most recent StatusEvent, moving through the states draft → published → claimed → picked_up → delivered (or expired or failed).
triggers: Donor opens the Tracking page and the DonationCard renders for each donation
A StatusEvent is recorded for a donation while the donor is viewing the page
side_effects: The DonationCard shows the status label and colour that match the latest StatusEvent
Donation.status is kept in sync with the latest StatusEvent so the card and the detail page agree
error_handling: If a donation has no StatusEvent history, the card shows the Donation.status value and logs a data inconsistency
If a StatusEvent is out of order, the card still shows the most recent by created_at

business_rules.name: match_info_shows_ngo_claim_and_portions
business_rules.description: Each card shows match information from the Claim records: the claiming NGO's name, the portions claimed, and the portions still unclaimed out of Donation.portions_total.
triggers: Donor views the DonationCard for a donation that has one or more Claims
An NGO claims all or part of a donation
side_effects: The card displays the claiming NGO's name and the claimed portions
The card displays how many portions remain unclaimed
error_handling: If a donation has no Claims, the card shows 'Awaiting NGO match' with the full portion count available
If a Claim references a missing Ngo record, the card shows 'NGO details unavailable' and does not hide the claimed portions

business_rules.name: unconfirmed_reservations_return_portions_to_available
business_rules.description: A Claim that is not confirmed within the configurable reservation timeout (default 5 minutes) is released, and its portions return to Donation.portions_available, which the card then reflects.
triggers: Claim.reserved_until passes without the NGO confirming the claim
Donor views the DonationCard after a reservation has expired
side_effects: Claim.status becomes released
Donation.portions_available increases by the released portions
The card no longer shows the released NGO as matched and shows the updated available portions
error_handling: If a release fails, the card shows the reservation as still held and the release is retried
If the donation has already passed its pickup-by time, the released portions are not made available and the card shows expired

business_rules.name: received_impact_shown_only_after_ngo_confirmation
business_rules.description: The card counts portions as rescued only when the NGO has confirmed receipt, using Claim.received_portions, and never counts claimed or picked-up portions as rescued.
triggers: Donor views a DonationCard for a donation whose Claim has been receipt-confirmed by the NGO
An NGO confirms the received quantity on the NGO Receipt page
side_effects: The card displays a 'rescued' figure equal to Claim.received_portions
Donation.status moves to delivered once receipt is confirmed
error_handling: If received_portions is missing, the card shows 'Receipt pending' instead of a rescued figure
If received_portions exceeds portions_claimed, the value is rejected and the card continues to show receipt pending

business_rules.name: donor_sees_only_own_restaurant_donations
business_rules.description: A donor's DonationCards only include donations whose restaurant belongs to that donor's account.
triggers: Donor loads the Tracking page
Donor requests a donation list for the Tracking page
side_effects: Only cards for the signed-in donor's restaurant donations are rendered
Donations from other restaurants are omitted without any error message
error_handling: If a donor has no restaurant record, the page shows an empty state prompting them to set up their restaurant
If a request targets another restaurant's donation, the request is refused and no card data is returned

steps.description: Donor opens one donation and reviews its details, handling declarations and ordered status history.

business_rules.name: donation_detail_visible_only_to_involved_parties
business_rules.description: A donation's detail page is available only to the donor who owns the donation's restaurant, the NGO holding a claim on it, the volunteer assigned to its pickup, and admins.
triggers: A signed-in user opens a donation's detail page from the Tracking list or a notification link
A user requests a donation by id directly in the address bar
side_effects: The donation's details, handling declarations and status history are shown to the authorised user
Nothing is written; the view is read-only
error_handling: A signed-in user with no link to the donation is refused, and the page reports that the donation was not found, without revealing that it exists
A donor from a different restaurant opening the donation gets the same not-found response
An unauthenticated visitor is sent to sign-in and returned to the donation after login

business_rules.name: handling_declarations_shown_exactly_as_recorded_for_donation
business_rules.description: The preparation time, storage/handling and allergen declarations displayed are those recorded on this specific donation and are never taken from restaurant preferences or earlier donations.
triggers: The donation detail page loads its handling declarations
side_effects: The HandlingDeclaration rows linked to this donation are displayed, one set per declaration
RestaurantPreference is not read for this page, so saved preferences never fill in safety fields
error_handling: A donation with no HandlingDeclaration rows shows a clear 'no handling declaration recorded' message rather than blank or inferred values
If a declaration row fails to load, the rest of the page still renders and the declarations section shows a retry option

business_rules.name: status_history_ordered_chronologically_and_append_only
business_rules.description: StatusEvent records for a donation are listed in the order they occurred (oldest first), and existing events are never edited or deleted, so corrections appear as new events.
triggers: The donation detail page loads the status history
A new status change is recorded for the donation while someone is viewing it
side_effects: The status timeline lists each StatusEvent in sequence, showing the from status, to status, actor and time
A status change made while the page is open appears on the next refresh or live update
error_handling: Two events with the same sequence_no are ordered by created_at, and the duplicate is logged for admin review
An attempt to edit or delete an existing StatusEvent is rejected and no history is altered

business_rules.name: donation_status_follows_latest_status_event
business_rules.description: The donation's current status shown on the detail page is the to_status of its most recent StatusEvent, moving through published → claimed → collected → delivered, with released or expired as exits when a claim lapses.
triggers: The donation detail page loads
A status transition is recorded against the donation
side_effects: The status badge on the detail page matches the timeline's final entry
error_handling: If Donation.status and the latest StatusEvent disagree, the timeline's latest event is shown and the mismatch is flagged for admin review

business_rules.name: reservation_timeout_release_recorded_in_history
business_rules.description: When a claimed portion is not confirmed within the reservation timeout (default 5 minutes), the release is recorded as a StatusEvent so the donor sees why the donation returned to available.
triggers: The reservation timeout elapses on an unconfirmed claim
The donation detail page loads after a release
side_effects: Unconfirmed portions return to Donation.available_portions
A StatusEvent records the release with the system as actor
The donor sees the release entry in the timeline
error_handling: If the release fails to write, the portions stay reserved and the release is retried on the next timeout check

business_rules.name: received_portions_shown_only_after_ngo_confirmation
business_rules.description: The donation detail page shows a delivered quantity only after the NGO has confirmed the received quantity, and labels it as confirmed rescued food; before that it shows the claimed quantity only.
triggers: The donation detail page loads a donation with an NGO receipt
side_effects: The confirmed portion count appears under a 'confirmed delivered' label
Claimed but unconfirmed portions are shown as pending, not as rescued
error_handling: A donation claimed but not yet received shows claimed portions and a pending label, never a confirmed count
A confirmed count greater than the claimed quantity is hidden and flagged for admin review

steps.description: Status history is rendered as an ordered timeline of events.

business_rules.name: status_timeline_ordered_chronologically
business_rules.description: A donation's status history is shown as an ordered timeline with the oldest event first and the most recent status last.
triggers: A donor, NGO, volunteer or admin opens a donation's detail page
A new status change is recorded against the donation
side_effects: The timeline on the donation detail page lists every StatusEvent for the donation in the order it occurred
The most recent StatusEvent determines the donation's current status shown at the top of the page
error_handling: If two StatusEvent records share the same created_at, they are ordered by their creation sequence so the timeline stays stable on reload
If a donation has no StatusEvent records, the timeline shows a message that no status changes have been recorded yet

business_rules.name: status_events_append_only
business_rules.description: StatusEvent records are written once when a status changes and are never edited or deleted, so the history shown on the timeline is a faithful record.
triggers: A donation status transition is performed by a donor, NGO, volunteer, admin or the reservation timeout
A participant attempts to edit or remove a past status event
side_effects: Each valid status change adds one new StatusEvent to the donation's history
Past StatusEvent entries remain unchanged on the timeline
error_handling: If an edit or delete of a StatusEvent is requested, the change is refused and the timeline is left as recorded
If a status change fails validation, no StatusEvent is written and the timeline does not show it

business_rules.name: status_history_visible_to_involved_parties
business_rules.description: The status timeline for a donation is visible only to the donor, the claiming NGO, the assigned volunteer and admins involved with that donation.
triggers: A user requests the donation detail page for a donation
A user who is not involved with the donation attempts to open its timeline
side_effects: The timeline renders for involved participants
Non-involved users are shown no timeline data
error_handling: If a user is not linked to the donation through a donor, claim, pickup or admin role, the timeline is not returned and the user is told the donation is not available to them
If the donation does not exist, the page shows a not-found message without revealing any events

name: Donor Saves Restaurant Preferences
description: A donor saves restaurant preferences for future posts while leaving safety declarations blank for each new post.

steps.description: Donor opens restaurant preferences and sees saved restaurant details and pickup preferences.

business_rules.name: preferences_visible_only_to_owning_donor
business_rules.description: A donor can view restaurant details and pickup preferences only for the Restaurant they own, and no other restaurant's data is returned.
triggers: Donor opens the restaurant preferences page
side_effects: The page shows the restaurant name and the saved pickup preferences for the donor's own restaurant
No records are changed by viewing the page
error_handling: If the signed-in user does not own the requested restaurant, access is denied and the page shows a not-authorised message
If the donor has no restaurant linked to their account, the page shows a message asking them to complete restaurant setup

business_rules.name: preferences_shown_only_for_approved_restaurant
business_rules.description: Restaurant status moves through pending → approved → suspended, and saved preferences are shown as active only while the Restaurant is approved.
triggers: Donor opens the restaurant preferences page
Admin approves or suspends the restaurant
side_effects: A pending restaurant sees its details with a notice that approval is awaiting admin review
A suspended restaurant sees its preferences marked read-only with a notice that the account is suspended
error_handling: If the restaurant status cannot be read, the page shows the details with a retry message and does not display preferences as active

business_rules.name: preferences_do_not_carry_safety_declarations
business_rules.description: The page displays only pickup preferences and restaurant details from RestaurantPreference and Restaurant, and never displays or pre-fills any HandlingDeclaration from earlier donations.
triggers: Donor opens the restaurant preferences page
side_effects: Safety declarations remain tied to individual donations and are not shown as saved restaurant preferences
error_handling: If a stored preference contains handling or allergen information, it is ignored on display and the donor is shown only the pickup fields

business_rules.name: missing_preferences_show_empty_state_without_writing
business_rules.description: When a Restaurant has no RestaurantPreference yet, the page shows an empty pickup-preferences state and does not create a RestaurantPreference record just by being viewed.
triggers: Donor opens the restaurant preferences page for a restaurant with no saved preferences
side_effects: The donor sees an empty pickup-preferences section with an invitation to add preferences
No RestaurantPreference record is created
error_handling: If the preference lookup fails, the page shows the restaurant details and a retry option for the preferences section

steps.description: Donor edits preferences and saves; safety declarations are not stored for reuse and are left blank for the next post.

business_rules.name: safety_declarations_never_saved_as_preferences
business_rules.description: Saving restaurant preferences stores only reusable defaults and never stores handling declarations (preparation time, storage/handling, allergens) for reuse on later posts.
triggers: Donor edits restaurant preferences and taps Save
side_effects: RestaurantPreference is updated with the donor's saved defaults
No HandlingDeclaration values are written from this step
Any previously entered safety declaration remains tied only to its original donation
error_handling: If the request includes handling declaration fields, they are ignored and not stored, and the save still succeeds with the reusable defaults
If the save fails on the server, the donor's edits are kept on screen and a retry message is shown

business_rules.name: next_post_starts_with_blank_handling_checklist
business_rules.description: The handling checklist for the next donation starts blank regardless of what was saved earlier, so the donor must complete it again for each post.
triggers: Donor opens Quick Post after saving restaurant preferences
Donor starts a repeat donation from the Donor Dashboard
side_effects: Quick Post opens with the handling checklist fields empty
Saved preference defaults such as portions and pickup window pre-fill the post form
error_handling: If no preferences exist, Quick Post opens with all defaults empty and the checklist still blank
The donor cannot publish a donation until the handling checklist is completed for that post

business_rules.name: preferences_are_per_restaurant_defaults
business_rules.description: Each restaurant has one set of saved preferences that only the donors of that restaurant can edit, and saving replaces the previous preference values.
triggers: Donor saves preferences on the Restaurant Preferences page
side_effects: RestaurantPreference for the donor's restaurant is replaced with the new values
RestaurantPreference.updated_at and updated_by_user_id record the save
error_handling: If the donor does not belong to the restaurant, the save is rejected and the donor sees a permission message
If two donors save at the same time, the last save wins and the earlier values are overwritten

validation_rules.description: Default portions must be a whole number from 1 to 200.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions between 1 and 200.

validation_rules.description: Default pickup window is a whole number of minutes from 15 to 240.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a pickup window between 15 and 240 minutes.

validation_rules.description: Pickup instructions are optional and limited to 280 characters.
validation_rules.error_message: Pickup instructions must be 280 characters or fewer.

validation_rules.description: At least one food type must be selected when preferred food types are set, and each selection must come from the allowed list.
validation_rules.error_message: Select at least one food type from the list.

name: NGO Claims a Donation
description: An NGO is alerted to eligible nearby donations, reviews match explanations and claims all or part of one within the confirmation window.

steps.description: NGO opens the feed and sees eligible nearby donations with match explanations and in-app alerts.

business_rules.name: feed_shows_only_claimable_donations
business_rules.description: The NGO feed lists only donations that are published, still have unallocated portions, and whose pickup-by time has not passed (published → partially_claimed → fully_claimed or expired, with only published and partially_claimed shown).
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
NGO refreshes the feed
A donation's pickup-by time passes or its last portion is claimed while the feed is open
side_effects: Donations that are fully claimed or past pickup-by are removed from the NGO's feed
Donation.status is set to expired when pickup_by_at passes with no portions claimed
