error_handling: If no donations are claimable, the feed shows an empty state explaining there are no current eligible donations, not an error
If a donation is claimed by another NGO between load and tap, the NGO is told the donation is no longer available when they try to claim it

business_rules.name: feed_limits_donations_to_ngo_service_area
business_rules.description: A donation appears in an NGO's feed only when the donating Restaurant is within the NGO's service_radius_km, measured from the NGO's latitude and longitude.
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
NGO changes service_radius_km or location on the NGO Capacity page
side_effects: Donations outside the radius are excluded from that NGO's feed and alerts
Donations inside the radius become visible to the NGO on the next feed load
error_handling: If the NGO has no coordinates set, the feed shows a prompt to add a location instead of nearby donations
If the restaurant has no coordinates, the donation is excluded from all radius-based feeds and the donor is told to add an address

business_rules.name: feed_matches_donation_to_ngo_need_and_capacity
business_rules.description: A donation appears only if the NGO is available, the donation's portions fit within the NGO's current need, and the NGO can handle any refrigeration the donation requires (available → matched against need and capacity).
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
NGO updates current need, capacity or availability on the NGO Capacity page
side_effects: Donations that exceed the NGO's max_portions_per_claim or need no longer appear for that NGO
Refrigerated donations are hidden from NGOs without cold storage
error_handling: If the NGO is marked unavailable, the feed shows only a notice that availability is off, with a link to change it
If no donation fits the current capacity, the feed shows an empty state suggesting the NGO review its capacity

business_rules.name: match_explanation_is_computed_per_card
business_rules.description: Each feed card shows up to three plain reasons the donation matches the NGO (distance, portions within need, pickup window, cold storage), computed when the feed loads and not stored.
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
NGO refreshes the feed
side_effects: Each donation card displays its match reasons to the NGO
error_handling: If a reason cannot be computed because data is missing, that reason is omitted and the card still displays
If all reasons are missing, the card shows the donation's basic details without an explanation

business_rules.name: feed_orders_by_urgency_then_distance
business_rules.description: Donations are ordered by pickup_by_at soonest first, with ties broken by distance from the NGO.
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
NGO refreshes the feed
side_effects: The most time-critical nearby donations appear first in the feed
error_handling: If two donations have equal pickup times and distance is unavailable, they are ordered by Donation.published_at, newest first

business_rules.name: portions_held_by_pending_claims_are_excluded
business_rules.description: Portions reserved by a Claim still within its reservation timeout are excluded from the feed's available count, and return to the feed when the reservation expires unconfirmed (reserved → confirmed or released after reserved_until).
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
Another NGO starts a claim on the same donation
A Claim's reserved_until time passes without confirmation
side_effects: Donation.portions_remaining drops while a claim is reserved
Donation.portions_remaining is restored and the donation reappears in the feed when the reservation is released
error_handling: If the feed shows a donation whose remaining portions just dropped to zero, it is removed on the next refresh
If the reservation timeout is changed by configuration, existing reservations keep their original reserved_until

business_rules.name: unapproved_or_suspended_ngo_sees_no_feed
business_rules.description: Only NGOs with approval_status approved see donations in the feed; pending or suspended NGOs see a status message instead (pending → approved or suspended).
triggers: NGO opens the NGO Feed page
Admin changes the NGO's approval status
side_effects: A pending NGO is shown that its account awaits admin approval
A suspended NGO is shown that its account is suspended and cannot claim donations
error_handling: If an NGO's approval changes while viewing the feed, the next feed load reflects the new status and removes claim actions

business_rules.name: new_matching_donation_alerts_ngo
business_rules.description: When a donation is published that matches an available NGO's radius, need and capacity, that NGO receives an in-app alert, and a push notification is also sent through OneSignal when it is configured, otherwise the in-app alert alone is shown.
triggers: A donor publishes a donation
An NGO's availability is switched on while matching donations exist
side_effects: Matching NGOs see an in-app alert on their NGO Feed
Matching NGOs receive a push notification via OneSignal when configured
Alerts are not sent to NGOs that are unavailable, suspended or pending approval
error_handling: If OneSignal is not configured or the push fails, the in-app alert is still shown and the failure is logged without blocking publishing
If an NGO has already been alerted for the same donation, it is not alerted again on refresh

steps.description: NGO receives a push alert on the device when a new eligible donation is published.

business_rules.name: only_eligible_donations_trigger_ngo_alerts
business_rules.description: An NGO is alerted about a newly published donation only if the donation is published, has portions still available, its pickup-by time has not passed, and it falls within the NGO's service area and current need.
triggers: A donor publishes a donation (Donation.status moves from draft to published)
An NGO's capacity or availability changes so that it becomes eligible for an existing donation
side_effects: Each eligible, approved NGO receives a push alert through OneSignal naming the donation and its match explanation
The alert is shown in the NGO's in-app feed
A StatusEvent records that the alert was sent to each NGO
NGOs that are ineligible, suspended or unavailable receive no alert
error_handling: If the donation has no portions available or its pickup-by time has passed, no alert is sent and the donation is left out of the feed
If OneSignal is not configured or the push fails, the donation still appears in the NGO Feed and the NGO is told alerts are off and to check the feed
If an NGO has no OneSignal subscription, the donation is still shown in the in-app feed without a push

business_rules.name: donation_must_be_published_and_declared_before_alerting
business_rules.description: A donation is only published to NGOs after its handling declaration is complete, moving from draft → published, and no alert is sent for a donation still in draft.
triggers: A donor completes the handling checklist and publishes the donation
side_effects: Donation.status becomes published
StatusEvent records the publication
The publication triggers the NGO alert rule
error_handling: If the handling declaration is incomplete, the donation stays in draft and no alert is sent
If publication is attempted on an already published or expired donation, the publish is refused and no duplicate alert is sent

business_rules.name: donation_alert_sent_once_per_ngo
business_rules.description: Each NGO receives at most one push alert per published donation, even if the donation is re-evaluated or the NGO's capacity changes again.
triggers: A donation is re-evaluated for eligibility after publication
An NGO updates its capacity or availability
side_effects: The NGO's feed keeps showing the donation without a second push
StatusEvent records only the first alert for that NGO and donation
error_handling: If an NGO becomes eligible again after a repeat evaluation, it sees the donation in the feed but receives no second push

steps.description: NGO reviews the donation's details and handling declarations before claiming.

business_rules.name: ngo_sees_only_eligible_donations
business_rules.description: An NGO may review a donation only if the NGO is approved and the donation is published with unclaimed portions and a pickup-by time still in the future (published → claimable).
triggers: NGO opens the donation detail page from the NGO Feed or a direct link
NGO requests a donation detail record
side_effects: Donation details and declarations are shown to the NGO if eligible
If the NGO is not approved or the donation is not eligible, the NGO is shown a read-only notice and no claim action appears
error_handling: NGO not approved: show 'Your organisation is pending admin approval' and hide details
Donation not published (claimed out, expired, cancelled): show current status with no claim action
Donation belongs to another NGO's private allocation or is outside the NGO's eligibility: respond as not found

business_rules.name: handling_declarations_shown_with_donation
business_rules.description: The donation's handling declarations (preparation time, storage and handling, allergens) are displayed together with the donation so the NGO reviews food safety information before claiming.
triggers: NGO opens the donation detail page
NGO refreshes the donation detail page
side_effects: The NGO sees the handling checklist and its declaration timestamp for this donation
Declarations with missing items are flagged as incomplete so the NGO can decide whether to proceed
error_handling: No declaration exists for the donation: show 'No handling declaration recorded' and block claiming until the donor completes it
Declaration incomplete: show missing items clearly

business_rules.name: declarations_are_fresh_per_donation
business_rules.description: The handling declarations shown are those recorded for this specific donation and are never taken from restaurant preferences, so an old safety declaration cannot stand in for a current one.
triggers: NGO opens the donation detail page
Donation detail is assembled for review
side_effects: Only the HandlingDeclaration linked to this Donation is displayed
RestaurantPreference data is never shown as safety information on the donation
error_handling: Only a saved RestaurantPreference exists and no donation declaration: show no declaration and block claiming

business_rules.name: claim_action_gated_by_remaining_portions_and_deadline
business_rules.description: The claim action is offered only when the donation has portions remaining and the current time is before pickup_by_at (published → claim window open).
triggers: NGO views the donation detail and remaining portions change
Pickup-by time passes while the NGO is viewing
side_effects: The NGO is directed to the NGO Claim step when claiming is available
When pickup_by_at has passed and the donation is unclaimed, Donation.status becomes expired
error_handling: Portions remaining is zero: show 'Fully claimed' and no claim action
Pickup-by time has passed: show 'Pickup window closed' and no claim action

business_rules.name: reservation_window_disclosed_before_claim
business_rules.description: The NGO is told that claiming starts a time-limited reservation (default 5 minutes, configurable) before any portions are held.
triggers: NGO views the donation detail with claimable portions
side_effects: The reservation countdown is explained on the page; no portions are reserved at this step
error_handling: Reservation timeout configuration missing: use the 5-minute default

business_rules.name: impact_estimate_disclosed_with_donation
business_rules.description: The estimated waste avoided for the donation is shown using the configured assumption of 0.35 kg per portion, labelled as an estimate.
triggers: NGO views the donation detail
side_effects: Estimated kilograms are displayed with the assumption stated on the page
error_handling: Assumption not configured: fall back to 0.35 kg per portion and label it as the default

business_rules.name: donation_detail_access_limited_to_involved_parties
business_rules.description: Donation details, declarations and status history are visible only to the donor restaurant, the claiming NGO, assigned volunteers and admins.
triggers: Any user requests a donation detail record
side_effects: Users without a relationship to the donation receive a not-found response
error_handling: User not involved in the donation: respond as not found without revealing the donation exists

business_rules.name: status_history_shown_in_order
business_rules.description: Status changes for the donation are shown in the order they occurred (published → claimed → collected → delivered, or expired/cancelled).
triggers: NGO views the donation detail
side_effects: NGO sees a timeline of donation status changes
error_handling: No status events recorded: show only the current Donation.status

steps.description: NGO claims all or part of the donation within the short confirmation window; the system reserves the portions and releases them if the reservation times out.

business_rules.name: claim_only_while_donation_is_open
business_rules.description: An NGO may claim a donation only while Donation.status is published and before Donation.pickup_by_at has passed.
triggers: NGO selects a donation and submits a claim on the NGO Claim page
side_effects: If the donation is not published or the pickup-by time has passed, no Claim record is created and the NGO sees that the donation is no longer available
error_handling: Donation already claimed out or withdrawn: reject the claim and show the donation as unavailable
Pickup-by time has passed: reject the claim and show that the pickup window has closed

business_rules.name: only_approved_ngo_can_claim
business_rules.description: Only an NGO whose Ngo.approval_status is approved may create a Claim.
triggers: NGO submits a claim on the NGO Claim page
side_effects: Claim is created only for approved NGOs; pending or suspended NGOs are refused and no portions are reserved
error_handling: NGO is pending admin approval: refuse the claim and explain that approval is required
NGO is suspended: refuse the claim and show that the account cannot claim food

business_rules.name: claim_quantity_within_remaining_portions
business_rules.description: The portions an NGO claims must be a whole number from 1 up to Donation.portions_available and up to NgoCapacity.max_portions_per_claim.
triggers: NGO enters the number of portions to claim and submits
side_effects: Claim.portions_claimed is stored only when within both limits; otherwise the claim is not created
error_handling: Requested portions exceed portions available: reject and show the remaining count
Requested portions exceed the NGO's per-claim capacity: reject and show the NGO's maximum

business_rules.name: partial_claims_allowed_and_remainder_stays_available
business_rules.description: An NGO may claim only part of a donation; the unclaimed portions remain available to other NGOs.
triggers: NGO claims fewer portions than Donation.portions_available
side_effects: Donation.portions_available is reduced by the reserved portions
Donation.status stays published while portions_available is greater than zero
Remaining portions are shown to other eligible NGOs in their feed
error_handling: Partial claim leaves zero portions: Donation.status moves to fully_claimed

business_rules.name: portions_never_over_allocated
business_rules.description: The sum of active Claim.portions_claimed for a donation may never exceed Donation.portions_total, enforced inside a database transaction so concurrent claims cannot both succeed for the same portions.
triggers: Two or more NGOs claim the same donation at nearly the same time
side_effects: The first claim to commit reserves its portions; the competing claim is refused with the updated remaining count
error_handling: Concurrent claim finds insufficient portions at commit: roll back and tell the NGO the remaining portions have changed
Transaction conflict: retry once, then refuse with a try-again message

business_rules.name: claim_reserved_until_confirmation_window_expires
business_rules.description: A new claim is created as reserved with Claim.reserved_until set to the current time plus the configurable reservation timeout (default 5 minutes), and the NGO must confirm it before that time.
triggers: NGO submits a claim
Reservation timeout elapses
side_effects: Claim.status becomes reserved and the countdown is shown to the NGO
Donation.portions_available is reduced by the reserved portions
error_handling: Reservation timeout elapses without confirmation: move to the timeout release rule

business_rules.name: unconfirmed_reservation_releases_portions
business_rules.description: A reserved claim not confirmed by Claim.reserved_until moves reserved → released and its portions return to Donation.portions_available.
triggers: Claim.reserved_until passes without NGO confirmation
side_effects: Claim.status becomes released
Donation.portions_available is increased by the released portions
Donation.status returns to published if it was fully_claimed
A StatusEvent records the release
The NGO is notified by push that its reservation expired
error_handling: NGO confirms just after expiry: refuse confirmation and state that the reservation has expired
Release job fails: retry so portions are not left locked

business_rules.name: claim_confirmation_moves_reserved_to_claimed
business_rules.description: When the NGO confirms within the window, Claim.status moves reserved → claimed and the portions are committed to that NGO.
triggers: NGO confirms the reserved claim before reserved_until
side_effects: Claim.status becomes claimed
A StatusEvent records the claim
The donor sees the claim on the Donation detail page
The donor is notified by push that the donation has been claimed
error_handling: Claim no longer reserved (already released or confirmed): refuse and show its current status

business_rules.name: status_changes_recorded_as_events
business_rules.description: Every Claim and Donation status change in this step is recorded as a StatusEvent with the prior and new status and the time of change.
triggers: Claim is reserved, confirmed or released
Donation moves between published and fully_claimed
side_effects: A StatusEvent row is appended to the donation's history visible on Donation Detail
error_handling: StatusEvent write fails: roll back the status change so history and state stay consistent

validation_rules.description: The number of portions to claim is required before the claim can be submitted.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter how many portions you want to claim.

validation_rules.description: Portions claimed is a whole number from 1 up to the portions still available on the donation and the NGO's per-claim maximum.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number between 1 and the portions still available for this donation (maximum per claim for your NGO: applies).

name: NGO Confirms Received Quantity
description: After handover, an NGO confirms the quantity it actually received, which feeds the confirmed impact figures.

steps.description: NGO opens the receipt page for a handed-over donation.

business_rules.name: receipt_visible_only_to_claiming_ngo
business_rules.description: An NGO can open the receipt for a donation only when its own Claim is attached to that donation, and no other NGO can view it.
triggers: NGO opens the receipt page for a handed-over donation
side_effects: The receipt details are shown only to the claiming NGO
Access attempts by any other NGO are refused and logged
error_handling: The NGO has no claim on this donation: show a not-found message without revealing that the donation exists
The claim belongs to another NGO: refuse access and show a not-found message
The user is not signed in as an NGO: redirect to sign-in

business_rules.name: receipt_requires_handed_over_donation
business_rules.description: The receipt page is available only when the Donation is in the handed_over state and the Claim has reached the handed_over state, following the sequence published → claimed → collected → handed_over → received.
triggers: NGO opens the receipt page for a donation
side_effects: The receipt form is shown with the claimed quantity
If the donation is not yet handed over, the NGO is sent back to the donation status view with no change to records
error_handling: Donation is still claimed or collected: show that the handover has not happened yet and offer no confirmation form
Donation is already received: show the confirmed quantity as read-only
Donation is cancelled or expired: show that no receipt is due

business_rules.name: viewing_receipt_does_not_change_state
business_rules.description: Opening the receipt page is read-only and does not move the Claim or Donation to a new status or alter the claimed quantity.
triggers: NGO opens the receipt page
side_effects: No status change or status history entry is created
The claimed portions shown are the values stored at claim time
error_handling: A concurrent status change happens while the page is open: the page reloads the current status on the next action rather than trusting stale data

steps.description: NGO enters the quantity actually received and confirms; the claim is marked received with the confirmed portions.

business_rules.name: received_portions_cannot_exceed_claimed_portions
business_rules.description: The NGO's confirmed received portions must be a whole number from 0 up to the number of portions it claimed, so no more food is recorded as delivered than was allocated.
triggers: NGO enters the received quantity and confirms receipt on the NGO Receipt page
side_effects: Claim.received_portions is stored when the value is within the claimed range
the NGO sees a confirmation that the receipt was recorded
error_handling: If the entered quantity is greater than Claim.claimed_portions, the confirmation is rejected and the NGO is asked to enter a quantity no greater than the claimed amount
If the entered quantity is negative or not a whole number, the confirmation is rejected and nothing is saved
If the server-side check fails because the claimed amount changed, the receipt is not saved and the NGO is shown the current claimed amount

business_rules.name: only_claiming_ngo_can_confirm_receipt
business_rules.description: Only the NGO that holds the claim may confirm receipt of its portions, and the claim must be in a state where receipt is still awaited (claimed → received).
triggers: NGO submits a receipt confirmation for a claim
side_effects: Claim.status changes from claimed to received when the confirmation succeeds
a StatusEvent is written recording the claimed → received transition
error_handling: If the requesting NGO does not own the claim, the request is refused and no change is made
If the claim is already received or is in a state that does not allow receipt, the confirmation is refused and the current status is shown
If the claim's reservation has expired and its portions were released, the NGO is told the claim is no longer valid and nothing is recorded

business_rules.name: confirmed_portions_are_the_only_rescued_portions_counted
business_rules.description: Only Claim.received_portions, set by NGO confirmation, count toward rescued and confirmed impact; claimed but unconfirmed portions do not.
triggers: Claim status becomes received
impact figures are recalculated for admin and sponsor views
side_effects: ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions is increased by Claim.received_portions
ImpactSummary.estimated_waste_avoided_kg is updated using the disclosed assumption of 0.35 kg per portion
error_handling: If the impact update fails, the receipt is still saved and the impact figures are recalculated on the next read
If a claim is never confirmed, its portions are excluded from impact totals

business_rules.name: receipt_confirmation_is_recorded_in_status_history
business_rules.description: Every successful receipt confirmation adds one status history entry showing the transition from claimed to received, with the time it occurred.
triggers: NGO confirms receipt successfully
side_effects: a StatusEvent is created with from_status claimed and to_status received
Claim.received_at is set to the confirmation time
the donation's status history shown on Donation Detail includes the receipt
error_handling: If the status event cannot be written, the claim update is rolled back so the claim is not marked received without a history record
Duplicate confirmation attempts do not create a second status event

business_rules.name: receipt_confirmation_is_protected_against_concurrent_updates
business_rules.description: Claim updates for receipt confirmation run in a transaction or equivalent lock so a claim cannot be confirmed twice or have its portions changed by a concurrent request.
triggers: two confirmation requests for the same claim arrive at nearly the same time
a confirmation request arrives while the claim is being released by the reservation timeout
side_effects: only the first valid confirmation is applied
the later request is told the claim is already received
error_handling: If the lock cannot be acquired within the request time limit, the NGO is asked to retry and no partial state is saved

business_rules.name: receipt_notification_sent_to_donor
business_rules.description: When a claim is confirmed as received, the donor is notified of the confirmed portion count through the configured notification channels.
triggers: Claim status changes to received
side_effects: the donor receives an email through resend with the confirmed portions
the donor receives a push notification through onesignal when configured
error_handling: If resend or onesignal is not configured or fails, the receipt is still saved and the donor sees the update on the Tracking page
If the donor has no email address on file, only the in-app status is updated

validation_rules.description: Received portions must be a whole number from 0 up to the number of portions claimed.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions from 0 to the claimed amount.

validation_rules.description: A received quantity must be entered before the receipt can be confirmed.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the number of portions you received.

steps.description: NGO sees the donation status move to confirmed delivery.

business_rules.name: donation_moves_to_confirmed_delivery_only_on_ngo_receipt
business_rules.description: A donation moves to confirmed delivery only after the claiming NGO confirms the received quantity, following the sequence posted → claimed → picked up → confirmed delivery.
triggers: NGO submits the received quantity on the NGO Receipt page
Confirmed quantity is saved against the claimed donation
side_effects: Donation.status becomes confirmed_delivery
Donation.received_portions is stored as the NGO-confirmed quantity
A StatusEvent is recorded with to_status set to confirmed_delivery and the time of the change
The donor sees the donation shown as confirmed delivery on the Donation Detail page
error_handling: Donation is not yet picked up: the status stays unchanged and the NGO is told the delivery cannot be confirmed yet
Received quantity is greater than the portions claimed: the confirmation is rejected and the status stays unchanged
A different NGO attempts to confirm a donation it did not claim: the request is refused and the status stays unchanged

business_rules.name: every_status_change_is_recorded_in_order
business_rules.description: Each change to a donation's status creates one StatusEvent in sequence, so the status history shown on the Donation Detail page matches what happened.
triggers: Donation status changes for any reason
A donor, NGO, volunteer or admin opens the Donation Detail page
side_effects: A StatusEvent is stored with the previous status, the new status and the time of the change
The Donation Detail page lists the status history in time order, ending with confirmed delivery
error_handling: Status change fails to save: the donation keeps its previous status and no StatusEvent is recorded

business_rules.name: only_confirmed_portions_count_toward_impact
business_rules.description: Impact is counted from received portions on donations in confirmed delivery status, and never from claimed or posted portions.
triggers: Donation status becomes confirmed delivery
Impact figures are recalculated for the sponsor dashboard
side_effects: ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions increases by the received portions of the newly confirmed donation
ImpactSummary.estimated_waste_avoided_kg is recalculated using the configured 0.35 kg per portion assumption
error_handling: Donation is not in confirmed delivery status: its portions are excluded from ImpactSummary
Impact assumption setting is missing: the default of 0.35 kg per portion is used and labelled as an assumption

name: NGO Updates Capacity and Need
description: An NGO sets its current need, carrying capacity and availability so the matching engine reflects what it can accept.

steps.description: NGO opens the capacity page and sees its current need, capacity and availability.

business_rules.name: ngo_sees_only_its_own_capacity
business_rules.description: An NGO user sees only the current need, capacity and availability of the NGO their account belongs to.
triggers: An NGO user opens the NGO Capacity page
side_effects: The page shows only the signed-in NGO's NgoCapacity record
Capacity figures belonging to other NGOs are not returned to this user
error_handling: If the signed-in user is not linked to an NGO, the page shows a message that no NGO profile is attached and displays no capacity data
If the user is not an NGO account, access to the page is denied

business_rules.name: capacity_visible_only_for_approved_ngo
business_rules.description: Capacity, need and availability are shown only when the Ngo status is approved; pending and suspended NGOs (pending → approved → suspended) see a status notice instead.
triggers: An NGO user opens the NGO Capacity page
An admin approves or suspends the NGO
side_effects: An approved NGO sees its capacity figures and editing controls
A pending or suspended NGO sees a notice that its account is not yet active, with no capacity figures shown
error_handling: If Ngo.status is pending, the page explains that admin approval is required before capacity can be managed
If Ngo.status is suspended, the page explains the account is suspended and directs the user to contact an admin

business_rules.name: capacity_snapshot_reflects_latest_saved_values
business_rules.description: The page displays the most recently saved NgoCapacity values for need, capacity and availability, together with the time they were last updated.
triggers: An NGO user opens the NGO Capacity page
An NGO user returns to the page after saving changes
side_effects: The displayed need, capacity and availability match the stored record at the time of viewing
The last-updated time is shown so the NGO knows how current the figures are
error_handling: If no NgoCapacity record exists yet for the NGO, the page shows empty values with a prompt to set them up
If the stored record cannot be loaded, the page shows a retry message rather than stale or default figures

steps.description: NGO updates need, capacity and availability and saves; the feed is reranked for future donations.

business_rules.name: only_approved_ngo_can_update_capacity
business_rules.description: An NGO's capacity record can be updated only when the Ngo is approved by an admin (pending → approved → suspended, with suspended NGOs blocked).
triggers: NGO submits the capacity form on the NGO Capacity page
side_effects: NgoCapacity is saved only for the signed-in approved Ngo
A pending or suspended NGO sees a message that its capacity cannot be changed until approval
error_handling: Ngo.approval_status is pending: save is rejected and the NGO is told its account is awaiting admin approval
Ngo.approval_status is suspended: save is rejected and the NGO is told its account is suspended
Signed-in user is not linked to an Ngo: save is rejected as unauthorized

business_rules.name: capacity_update_reranks_future_feed_only
business_rules.description: Saving need, capacity and availability reranks the NGO's eligible feed for future donations, while donations already claimed or reserved keep their existing allocations.
triggers: NGO saves a new need, capacity or availability value
side_effects: NgoCapacity.updated_at is set to the save time
The NGO Feed ordering for this NGO is recalculated using the new need and capacity values
Existing Claim records are left unchanged
error_handling: Save fails midway: previous NgoCapacity values are kept and the NGO is asked to retry
Feed recalculation fails after save: the saved values stand and the feed is refreshed on next load

business_rules.name: paused_availability_excludes_ngo_from_matching
business_rules.description: When availability is set to paused, the NGO is removed from the eligible feed for new donations until it is set back to accepting (accepting ↔ paused).
triggers: NGO sets availability to paused
NGO sets availability back to accepting
side_effects: Future donations are not shown to the NGO in its feed while paused
Returning to accepting restores the NGO to the eligible feed for new donations
error_handling: Availability value is not one of the allowed options: save is rejected and the previous value is kept

business_rules.name: need_and_capacity_are_non_negative_whole_portions
business_rules.description: Current need and carrying capacity are stored as whole-number portion counts that are zero or greater, and the server enforces this regardless of the client.
triggers: NGO submits need or capacity values
side_effects: Only valid whole-number portion values are persisted to NgoCapacity
error_handling: Negative or non-integer value: save is rejected with a message asking for whole portions
Value above the configured maximum: save is rejected with the maximum shown

validation_rules.description: Current need is a whole number from 0 to the configured maximum portions.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions between 0 and the allowed maximum.

validation_rules.description: Carrying capacity is a whole number from 0 to the configured maximum portions.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions between 0 and the allowed maximum.

validation_rules.description: Availability must be selected as either accepting or paused.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose whether the NGO is accepting donations or paused.

name: Volunteer Accepts and Completes a Pickup
description: A volunteer toggles availability, accepts a pickup, confirms collection and handover, and follows status updates for the delivery.

steps.description: Volunteer toggles availability on and sets carrying capacity on the tasks page.

business_rules.name: volunteer_availability_controls_pickup_visibility
business_rules.description: A volunteer toggles availability on or off, and only volunteers who are available see open pickups they can accept.
triggers: Volunteer switches the availability toggle on the volunteer tasks page
Volunteer switches the availability toggle off
side_effects: User.is_available is set to true or false
When available, open pickups that fit the volunteer's carrying capacity appear on the volunteer's task list
When unavailable, no open pickups are offered to the volunteer
error_handling: If the volunteer turns availability on without a carrying capacity set, availability is not saved and the volunteer is told to set a capacity first
If the volunteer's account is suspended by an admin, the toggle is disabled and the volunteer is told the account is not active

business_rules.name: carrying_capacity_required_before_availability
business_rules.description: A volunteer must set a whole-number carrying capacity, in portions, before they can be marked available.
triggers: Volunteer enters or changes carrying capacity on the volunteer tasks page
Volunteer attempts to turn availability on
side_effects: User.carrying_capacity is saved as the volunteer's current capacity in portions
Pickup eligibility for this volunteer is recalculated against the new capacity
error_handling: If capacity is empty or not a positive whole number, the capacity is not saved and the availability toggle stays off
If capacity exceeds the platform maximum, the value is rejected with the allowed range shown

business_rules.name: pickups_offered_must_fit_carrying_capacity
business_rules.description: An open pickup is offered to a volunteer only when its portion count is less than or equal to that volunteer's carrying capacity.
triggers: Volunteer's carrying capacity is saved
Volunteer's availability is turned on
A new pickup is opened for volunteers
side_effects: Pickups larger than the volunteer's capacity are hidden from that volunteer's task list
Pickups that fit are listed with their portion count so the volunteer can accept them
error_handling: If no open pickups fit the volunteer's capacity, the task list shows an empty state explaining that a larger capacity or a different time may be needed
If a pickup is accepted by another volunteer between listing and acceptance, the volunteer is told it is no longer available

business_rules.name: capacity_cannot_drop_below_committed_portions
business_rules.description: A volunteer cannot lower carrying capacity below the total portions of pickups they have already accepted and not yet handed over (accepted → collected → handed_over).
triggers: Volunteer lowers carrying capacity while holding one or more accepted pickups
side_effects: The new capacity is saved only if it still covers all committed portions
Pickups already accepted by the volunteer keep their assignment
error_handling: If the new capacity is below committed portions, the change is rejected and the message states the minimum capacity needed for current pickups

business_rules.name: availability_cannot_turn_off_during_active_pickup
business_rules.description: A volunteer cannot switch availability off while holding an accepted pickup that has not yet been handed over.
triggers: Volunteer switches availability off while a pickup is in accepted or collected status
side_effects: User.is_available stays true until the volunteer completes or hands over the pickup
The volunteer is directed to the active delivery screen
error_handling: If the volunteer attempts to go offline mid-delivery, the toggle reverts and the volunteer is told to finish the current pickup first

validation_rules.description: Carrying capacity is required before a volunteer can turn availability on.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter how many portions you can carry before going available.

validation_rules.description: Carrying capacity is a whole number from 1 to 100 portions.
validation_rules.error_message: Carrying capacity must be a whole number between 1 and 100 portions.

validation_rules.description: Carrying capacity must be entered as digits only, with no decimals or units.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter the number of portions as digits only, for example 12.

validation_rules.description: The availability toggle always has an explicit on or off value when saved.
validation_rules.error_message: Availability could not be saved. Please try again.

steps.description: Volunteer receives a push alert for an available pickup and accepts it.

business_rules.name: pickup_accepted_by_one_volunteer_only
business_rules.description: A Pickup moves from available → accepted exactly once, and only the first volunteer to accept it is assigned; later acceptances are refused.
triggers: Volunteer taps Accept on a pickup alert or card in the Volunteer Tasks page
Two volunteers accept the same pickup at nearly the same moment
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes accepted
Pickup.volunteer_id is set to the accepting volunteer's User.id
Pickup.accepted_at is recorded
A StatusEvent is written noting the pickup was accepted
The pickup is removed from every other volunteer's available list and alert
error_handling: If the pickup is already accepted, the second volunteer sees 'This pickup was just taken by another volunteer' and the list refreshes
If the pickup was cancelled or released before the tap, the volunteer sees 'This pickup is no longer available'
The check and the assignment run in one database transaction so a pickup is never assigned to two volunteers

business_rules.name: only_approved_available_volunteers_can_accept
business_rules.description: A volunteer may accept a pickup only when their account is admin-approved and they are currently toggled available.
triggers: Volunteer taps Accept on an available pickup
side_effects: Pickup.volunteer_id is set only if the checks pass
If checks fail, no Pickup change is made
error_handling: If the volunteer is not yet approved, the response says 'Your account is awaiting admin approval' and no assignment is made
If the volunteer is toggled unavailable, the response says 'Turn on availability to accept pickups' and no assignment is made
Permission is checked on the server, not only by hiding the button

business_rules.name: pickup_must_fit_volunteer_carrying_capacity
business_rules.description: A volunteer may accept a pickup only when the pickup's portion count does not exceed the volunteer's declared carrying capacity.
triggers: Volunteer taps Accept on a pickup whose quantity is larger than their capacity
side_effects: Pickup.volunteer_id is set only when the capacity check passes
error_handling: If the pickup is too large, the response says 'This pickup exceeds your carrying capacity of N portions' and offers to update capacity
Pickups with no recorded quantity are shown with a warning and the capacity check is skipped

business_rules.name: pickup_must_be_within_donation_pickup_window
business_rules.description: A pickup can be accepted only while its donation's pickup-by time has not passed and its linked claim is still confirmed.
triggers: Volunteer taps Accept after the pickup-by time has passed
Volunteer taps Accept on a pickup whose claim was released or cancelled
side_effects: Pickup.status stays available and no volunteer is assigned when the window has closed
The pickup is marked expired when its pickup-by time passes unassigned
error_handling: If the pickup-by time has passed, the response says 'The pickup window for this donation has closed'
If the claim is no longer active, the response says 'This pickup is no longer needed' and the pickup is removed from the list

business_rules.name: accepted_pickup_notifies_donor_and_ngo
business_rules.description: When a pickup is accepted, the donor and the receiving NGO are told which volunteer is collecting it and when.
triggers: Pickup.status changes from available to accepted
side_effects: A OneSignal push notification is sent to the donor's restaurant and the NGO's users
A Resend email is sent to the NGO contact summarising the assigned volunteer
The Tracking and Donation Detail views show the assigned volunteer and status
error_handling: If OneSignal is not configured or fails, the acceptance still succeeds and the status is shown in-app on next load
If Resend is not configured, the email is skipped and an in-app status update is shown instead

steps.description: Volunteer reviews pickup details and handling declarations before collecting.

business_rules.name: volunteer_sees_donation_details_only_for_own_pickup
business_rules.description: A volunteer can view a donation's details and handling declarations only when a Pickup they hold is linked to that donation.
triggers: Volunteer opens the donation detail page from an accepted pickup
Volunteer requests a donation detail they were not assigned
side_effects: The donation details and handling declarations are shown to the assigned volunteer
Nothing is shown to a volunteer with no link to the donation
error_handling: Volunteer has no Pickup for this donation: the page shows an access-denied message and no donation details
Donation does not exist: the page shows a not-found message

business_rules.name: handling_declarations_must_be_complete_before_collection
business_rules.description: The volunteer may proceed to collection only when the donation has a complete HandlingDeclaration (preparation time, storage/handling and allergens recorded), moving from pending review → cleared for collection.
triggers: Volunteer reviews the handling declarations on the donation detail page
Volunteer taps through to collection from this step
side_effects: Donation.status is treated as cleared for collection when the declaration is complete
Collection is blocked and the volunteer is shown what is missing when it is incomplete
error_handling: HandlingDeclaration is missing or incomplete: collection is blocked and the volunteer sees which declaration fields are missing
Donation has no HandlingDeclaration at all: collection is blocked and the donor is shown that the checklist must be completed

business_rules.name: collection_blocked_after_pickup_by_time
business_rules.description: A volunteer cannot begin collection once the current time has passed Donation.pickup_by_at, and the donation moves from claimed → expired for collection.
triggers: Volunteer opens the donation detail page after the pickup-by time
Volunteer attempts to proceed to collection after the pickup-by time
side_effects: The donation is marked as no longer collectable and the pickup is flagged for admin attention
The volunteer sees that the pickup window has closed
error_handling: Pickup-by time has passed: collection is blocked and the volunteer is shown the expired window
Pickup-by time is missing on the donation: collection is blocked until the donor corrects it

business_rules.name: impact_assumption_disclosed_on_donation_detail
business_rules.description: The donation detail page shows the estimated portion weight of 0.35 kg per portion alongside the donation's portion count, labelled as an assumption.
triggers: Volunteer views the donation detail page
side_effects: Estimated weight is displayed as an assumption, not a measured value
error_handling: Donation.portions is missing: the estimated weight is hidden and the page notes the quantity is unknown

steps.description: Volunteer confirms collection and then handover on the active delivery screen.

business_rules.name: pickup_status_must_advance_in_order
business_rules.description: A pickup moves through accepted → collected → handed_over, and no step can be skipped or reversed.
triggers: Volunteer taps confirm collection on the active delivery screen
Volunteer taps confirm handover on the active delivery screen
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes collected when collection is confirmed
Pickup.collected_at is set to the confirmation time
Pickup.status becomes handed_over only after it is collected
Pickup.handed_over_at is set to the confirmation time
error_handling: Handover is attempted before collection: reject the request and keep Pickup.status unchanged
Collection is attempted on a pickup that is not accepted (for example already collected or cancelled): reject the request and show the current status
Pickup is already handed_over: reject the request and show that handover is complete

business_rules.name: only_assigned_volunteer_can_confirm_pickup
business_rules.description: Only the volunteer who accepted a pickup can confirm its collection or handover.
triggers: Volunteer taps confirm collection on the active delivery screen
Volunteer taps confirm handover on the active delivery screen
side_effects: No Pickup field changes when the check fails
error_handling: Signed-in user is not Pickup.volunteer_id: reject the request with a not-permitted response and change nothing
Session has expired: ask the volunteer to sign in again and keep Pickup.status unchanged

business_rules.name: every_pickup_transition_is_logged
business_rules.description: Each confirmed collection or handover creates one status event recording the change, the actor and the time.
triggers: Pickup.status changes to collected
Pickup.status changes to handed_over
side_effects: A StatusEvent is appended with from_status, to_status, the volunteer as actor and the confirmation time
The donation detail history shows the new event
error_handling: Status event write fails: roll back the Pickup.status change so the pickup and its history never disagree

business_rules.name: handover_does_not_count_as_rescued_impact
business_rules.description: A completed handover marks food as delivered to the NGO but does not count as rescued impact until the NGO confirms the received quantity.
triggers: Pickup.status changes to handed_over
side_effects: Claim.status becomes awaiting_receipt
Donation.status becomes awaiting_receipt
ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions is not changed by this step
error_handling: Claim is missing or no longer active when handover is confirmed: keep the pickup record, flag it for admin review and do not change ImpactSummary

business_rules.name: collection_must_occur_before_donation_pickup_deadline
business_rules.description: Collection is accepted only while the donation's pickup-by time has not passed.
triggers: Volunteer taps confirm collection on the active delivery screen
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes collected when the deadline has not passed
Late collection attempts leave Pickup.status unchanged and flag the pickup for admin review
error_handling: Current time is after Donation.pickup_by_at: reject the collection, show that the pickup window has closed and notify admins to resolve the failed assignment
Donation.pickup_by_at is missing: reject the collection and ask an admin to correct the donation record

business_rules.name: handover_notifies_receiving_ngo
business_rules.description: When handover is confirmed, the receiving NGO is told so it can confirm the received quantity.
triggers: Pickup.status changes to handed_over
side_effects: A push notification is sent through onesignal to the NGO
An email is sent through resend to the NGO contact asking them to confirm the received quantity on the receipt screen
error_handling: onesignal is not configured or fails: still record the handover and send the email through resend
resend is not configured or fails: still record the handover and show the NGO the pending receipt in the NGO feed

business_rules.name: confirmation_actions_are_idempotent
business_rules.description: Repeating a confirmation for the same transition does not create a second status change or a second status event.
triggers: Volunteer taps confirm collection more than once
Volunteer taps confirm handover more than once
Slow network causes a confirmation request to be retried
side_effects: A repeated request returns the current status and creates no new StatusEvent
error_handling: Two confirmations arrive at the same time: accept only the first in a transaction and return the resulting status to the second

steps.description: Volunteer sees simple status updates for the delivery as it progresses.

business_rules.name: pickup_status_moves_forward_only
business_rules.description: A pickup moves through accepted → collected → handed_over in that order, and no step may be skipped or reversed.
triggers: Volunteer confirms collection of the food
Volunteer confirms handover to the NGO
A status change is attempted on a pickup that is already complete or cancelled
side_effects: Pickup.status is updated to the new stage only when the transition is the next valid one
The volunteer's timeline shows the new stage as the current step
Invalid transitions leave Pickup.status unchanged
error_handling: Handover confirmation attempted before collection: rejected, Pickup.status stays at accepted, and the volunteer sees that collection must be confirmed first
Status change on a completed or cancelled pickup: rejected with a message that the pickup is closed
Two devices confirm the same stage at once: only one transition is applied and the other is told the status has already changed

business_rules.name: status_event_logged_for_every_transition
business_rules.description: Every accepted status change creates one StatusEvent recording the pickup, the new status, the acting volunteer and the time, and past events are never edited or deleted.
triggers: A pickup status transition succeeds
Volunteer views the status timeline for an active pickup
side_effects: A new StatusEvent is appended to the pickup's history with the time and volunteer who made the change
The timeline gains one new entry, shown in the order it happened
Pickup.status matches the most recent StatusEvent
error_handling: Event write fails after the status change: the transition is rolled back so the pickup and its history never disagree
Attempt to edit or delete an existing StatusEvent: refused, history stays as recorded

business_rules.name: timeline_shows_only_the_assigned_volunteer_and_related_parties
business_rules.description: The status timeline for a pickup is visible to the volunteer assigned to it, and to the donor and NGO linked to the related donation, and to admins.
triggers: Volunteer opens the active delivery view
Donor or NGO opens the donation detail page showing the pickup timeline
Any other signed-in user requests a pickup's timeline
side_effects: The volunteer sees the full timeline for their own pickup
The donor and NGO for the linked donation see the same timeline entries
Users with no link to the pickup see nothing
error_handling: Volunteer requests a pickup assigned to someone else: access denied and no events are returned
Pickup has no events yet: timeline shows only the accepted stage without errors

business_rules.name: status_change_notifies_stakeholders_with_fallback
business_rules.description: When a pickup moves to a new status, the donor and NGO are sent a push notification through OneSignal, and when OneSignal is not configured the change appears only in the in-app timeline.
triggers: A pickup status transition succeeds
OneSignal is unavailable or not configured
side_effects: The donor and NGO for the linked claim receive a push notification naming the new stage through OneSignal
When OneSignal is not configured, no push is sent and the timeline entry is the only record of the update
The status change itself is saved regardless of notification success
error_handling: OneSignal request fails: the status change still stands, the failure is logged, and the timeline still shows the update
No push subscription for a recipient: the update is skipped for that recipient without blocking the transition

name: Admin Approves, Monitors and Resolves Rescues
description: An admin approves or suspends participants, monitors active rescues, and resolves failed assignments.

steps.description: Admin opens operations and sees pending participants awaiting approval.

business_rules.name: only_admin_can_view_pending_participants
business_rules.description: Only users with the admin role can open the operations view and see participants whose accounts are pending approval (pending → approved or pending → suspended).
triggers: An admin opens the Admin Operations page
A non-admin user or signed-out visitor attempts to open the Admin Operations page
side_effects: The Admin Operations page lists every User whose status is pending, showing their name, role (donor, NGO, volunteer or sponsor) and sign-up date
Opening the page changes no User.status values and sends no notifications
error_handling: If the requester is not signed in, they are redirected to the Login page
If the requester is signed in but User.role is not admin, access is denied and they see a not-authorised message; no pending participant data is returned
If there are no pending users, the page shows an empty-queue message instead of an error
If loading the pending list fails, the page shows a retry option and does not show partial or stale approval data

business_rules.name: pending_participants_are_excluded_from_matching_until_approved
business_rules.description: A User whose status is pending cannot act as a donor, NGO or volunteer, so the admin's view of pending participants is the only way they enter the active pool (pending → approved).
triggers: An admin views the pending participant list on the Admin Operations page
A newly signed-up donor, NGO or volunteer attempts to act while still pending
side_effects: Pending users appear in the admin's review queue and are not offered donations, claims or pickups
Approval and suspension decisions made from this view are later applied to User.status
error_handling: If a pending user tries to post, claim or accept work, the action is refused and they see a message that their account is awaiting admin approval
If an admin's decision is attempted on a user whose status has already changed elsewhere, the page refreshes the queue and shows the current status rather than overwriting it

steps.description: Admin approves or suspends a participant; the participant is notified by email of the decision.

business_rules.name: participant_approval_decision
business_rules.description: A newly signed-up participant moves from pending → approved or pending → suspended based on an admin's decision, and an approved or suspended participant can be moved to the other state.
triggers: Admin selects Approve on a pending participant in Admin Operations
Admin selects Suspend on a participant in Admin Operations
Admin reverses a previous decision (suspended → approved, or approved → suspended)
side_effects: User.approval_status is set to approved or suspended
User.decided_at and User.decided_by_user_id record when and which admin made the decision
A StatusEvent entry is written recording the participant, the previous state, the new state and the admin
error_handling: If the User has already been moved to the requested state by another admin, the action is rejected and the admin sees the current status
If the User record cannot be updated, the approval status is left unchanged and the admin is told the decision did not save

business_rules.name: approval_decision_emails_participant
business_rules.description: When an admin approves or suspends a participant, the participant is emailed through Resend to tell them the decision.
triggers: User.approval_status is saved as approved
User.approval_status is saved as suspended
side_effects: The participant receives an email via Resend stating they have been approved, or that their participation is suspended
The email is sent to User.email and names the decision and the date it was made
error_handling: If Resend fails to send, the approval decision is still saved and the email is queued for retry
If the participant has no valid User.email, no email is sent and the admin is shown a warning that the participant could not be notified

business_rules.name: suspended_user_cannot_act
business_rules.description: A participant whose User.approval_status is suspended cannot sign in to act on donations, claims, receipts or pickups, and sees a message that their participation is suspended.
triggers: A suspended participant attempts to sign in
A suspended participant attempts a donor, NGO or volunteer action on any page
side_effects: The participant is shown a suspension message instead of the working screens
No new Donation, Claim, Pickup or Pickup acceptance is created for the suspended participant
error_handling: If a suspended participant's session is still active, the next server-side request is refused and the session is ended
If a suspended participant tries an action directly, the server rejects it with a suspension message and makes no change

business_rules.name: only_admin_can_approve_or_suspend
business_rules.description: Only a User whose role is admin can approve or suspend participants, and this is enforced on the server rather than only hidden in the interface.
triggers: A non-admin user submits an approve or suspend action
An admin opens Admin Operations and makes a decision
side_effects: For a non-admin request, User.approval_status is left unchanged
The rejected attempt is recorded as a StatusEvent
error_handling: A non-admin request is refused with a permission message and no User record is changed
A request from a signed-out visitor is redirected to sign-in

business_rules.name: suspension_surfaces_open_assignments
business_rules.description: When a participant is suspended while they hold open Claims or Pickups, those assignments are flagged for admin resolution rather than silently completed or dropped.
triggers: Admin suspends a participant who has an open Claim or Pickup
side_effects: Open Claims and Pickups linked to the suspended participant are marked as needing admin review
The affected Donation appears in Admin Operations so the admin can resolve the failed assignment
A StatusEvent entry is written for each flagged assignment
error_handling: If there are no open assignments, suspension completes with no further changes
If a flagged Pickup is already confirmed as handed over, it is not reopened and is left as completed

business_rules.name: suspended_participant_can_be_reapproved
business_rules.description: A suspended participant can be moved back to approved by an admin, which restores access and triggers a new decision email.
triggers: Admin selects Approve on a participant whose User.approval_status is suspended
side_effects: User.approval_status becomes approved
The participant is emailed through Resend that their participation has been restored
error_handling: If the email cannot be sent, the approval is kept and the email is queued for retry

steps.description: Admin monitors active rescues and identifies a failed assignment.

business_rules.name: admin_sees_all_in_progress_rescues
business_rules.description: Admin sees every donation that has a claim or pickup still in progress, with its claim and pickup status, so no active rescue is hidden from oversight.
triggers: Admin opens the Admin Operations page
Admin refreshes the active rescues list
side_effects: Admin sees the list of active rescues, each with its donation, claim and pickup status
No record is changed by viewing the list
error_handling: If a user without the admin role opens the page, access is denied and no rescue data is returned
If a donation has no claim or pickup yet, it is shown as awaiting claim rather than omitted

business_rules.name: pickup_failed_when_unaccepted_past_pickup_by
business_rules.description: A pickup is flagged as failed when no volunteer has accepted it and the donation's pickup-by time has passed (unassigned → failed).
triggers: Donation.pickup_by_at passes while Pickup.status is still unassigned
Admin page is loaded or refreshed after the pickup-by time
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes failed
Donation.status is marked as needing admin attention
A StatusEvent is recorded with the reason 'no volunteer accepted before pickup-by time'
Admin is notified through a push alert
error_handling: If a volunteer accepts the pickup in the same moment the deadline passes, the server accepts whichever write commits first and the other is rejected with a conflict
If the push notification fails, the failed pickup still appears in the admin list

business_rules.name: pickup_failed_when_accepted_but_not_collected_in_time
business_rules.description: A pickup is flagged as failed when a volunteer accepted it but has not confirmed collection by the pickup-by time (accepted → failed).
triggers: Donation.pickup_by_at passes while Pickup.status is accepted
Admin page is loaded or refreshed after the pickup-by time
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes failed
A StatusEvent is recorded with the reason 'accepted pickup not collected by pickup-by time', including the volunteer on the pickup
Admin is notified through a push alert
error_handling: If collection is confirmed in the same moment the deadline passes, the confirmed collection wins and the pickup is not flagged
If the volunteer's account is suspended, the pickup is still flagged and the admin sees the suspension

business_rules.name: expired_reservation_releases_portions
business_rules.description: A claim not confirmed within the reservation timeout (default 5 minutes) expires and its unconfirmed portions return to the donation (reserved → expired).
triggers: Claim.reserved_until passes while Claim.status is still reserved
Admin page is loaded and an expired claim is detected
side_effects: Claim.status becomes expired
Claim.portions_claimed is released back to Donation.portions_remaining
Donation.status returns to posted if no other claim is active
A StatusEvent is recorded for the expiry
error_handling: If the NGO confirms the claim at the moment it expires, the server applies whichever write commits first and the other is rejected
If the timeout has been changed in configuration, the new value applies only to claims made after the change

business_rules.name: admin_cannot_edit_status_directly
business_rules.description: Admin monitoring is read-only on statuses: status changes to donations, claims and pickups are made only by the server's transition rules and recorded as StatusEvents.
triggers: Admin attempts to change Donation.status, Claim.status or Pickup.status from the monitoring view
Any status change is requested through the interface
side_effects: Each allowed transition writes one StatusEvent with the previous and new status
Disallowed transitions are rejected and nothing is changed
error_handling: If a transition is not allowed from the current status, the change is rejected and the current status is shown
If the record was changed by someone else since it was loaded, the admin is asked to refresh

business_rules.name: failed_assignments_excluded_from_confirmed_impact
business_rules.description: Donations and pickups with failed or expired assignments are excluded from confirmed impact, so only NGO-confirmed portions count toward ImpactSummary.
triggers: Pickup.status becomes failed
Claim.status becomes expired
side_effects: ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions is not increased by the failed or expired assignment
The failed portions remain available to be reassigned
error_handling: If a failed pickup was later collected and receipt confirmed, the portions are counted once, on confirmation

steps.description: Admin opens the donation to review details and status history of the rescue.

business_rules.name: donation_detail_visible_only_to_involved_parties
business_rules.description: A Donation's details and status history are visible only to its donor restaurant's users, the NGO holding a Claim on it, the volunteer assigned to its Pickup, and admins.
triggers: A signed-in user opens a donation's detail page by its id
side_effects: The page shows the donation's details, handling declarations and status history to an authorised viewer
A user with no involvement in the donation sees a not-found response, and nothing is shown
error_handling: User is not a donor for this restaurant, has no Claim or Pickup on this donation, and is not an admin: the page is withheld and the user sees a not-found message
User is not signed in: the user is sent to login and returned to this donation after signing in
Donation id does not exist: the user sees a not-found message

business_rules.name: status_history_shown_in_chronological_order
business_rules.description: The StatusEvent history for a Donation is shown oldest first, with each event displaying its from-status, to-status, actor and timestamp.
triggers: The donation detail page loads for an authorised viewer
side_effects: The viewer sees each state change in order, from posting through claim, pickup, handover and any admin resolution
The current Donation.status shown matches the most recent StatusEvent.to_status
error_handling: Donation has no StatusEvent rows: the page shows the current status with a note that no history is recorded yet
A StatusEvent references an actor who has since been removed: the event is still shown, with the actor labelled as unavailable

business_rules.name: status_history_is_append_only
business_rules.description: StatusEvent rows are never edited or deleted once written, so the history of a Donation always reflects every transition that occurred.
triggers: Any status change to a Donation is recorded
The detail page is viewed and history is read
side_effects: Each status change adds a new StatusEvent rather than overwriting an earlier one
The detail page reads history without changing any Donation or StatusEvent data
error_handling: An attempt to edit or remove a StatusEvent is rejected and logged
A status change that cannot be recorded as a new StatusEvent is not applied to the Donation

business_rules.name: viewing_donation_detail_changes_no_state
business_rules.description: Opening the donation detail page is read-only and does not change the Donation status, any Claim, Pickup or StatusEvent.
triggers: An authorised user opens the donation detail page
side_effects: No StatusEvent is created by viewing the page
Donation.status is unchanged after the page loads
error_handling: A request on this page that attempts a write is refused and the user is shown the current donation without changes

business_rules.name: handling_declarations_belong_to_this_donation
business_rules.description: The HandlingDeclaration shown on a Donation is the fresh checklist completed for that specific donation, never values copied from RestaurantPreference.
triggers: The detail page loads the handling information for a donation
side_effects: The page shows only the safety declarations made for this donation
Saved restaurant preferences do not appear as declarations on the donation
error_handling: Donation has no HandlingDeclaration: the page states that no handling checklist was recorded for this donation
Declaration fields are incomplete: the missing items are shown as not declared

business_rules.name: only_confirmed_portions_count_as_rescued
business_rules.description: The donation detail shows claimed portions separately from NGO-confirmed portions, and only confirmed portions are presented as rescued food.
triggers: The detail page loads quantity and impact information for a donation
side_effects: The page shows total, claimed and confirmed portions for the donation
Estimated waste avoided, at the disclosed 0.35 kg per portion, is derived from confirmed portions only and labelled as an assumption
error_handling: Claim exists but no receipt is confirmed: the portions are shown as claimed and pending confirmation, not as rescued
Confirmed portions exceed claimed portions: the discrepancy is flagged for admin review instead of being displayed as rescued

business_rules.name: unknown_donation_returns_not_found
business_rules.description: A request for a Donation id that does not exist returns a not-found result without revealing whether the id belongs to another restaurant.
triggers: A user navigates to a donation id that is not in the system
side_effects: The user sees a not-found message and no donation data
error_handling: Malformed id: the user is shown a not-found message

steps.description: Admin resolves the failed assignment by reassigning or releasing the portions, and the status history records the outcome.

business_rules.name: failed_assignment_must_be_reassigned_or_released
business_rules.description: A failed assignment is resolved by an admin choosing one outcome, either reassigning the claimed portions to another eligible NGO or releasing them, and it is not left open (Pickup.status: failed → reassigned or released).
triggers: Admin opens a failed assignment in the Admin Operations page
Admin selects reassign or release and confirms the resolution
side_effects: Pickup.status becomes reassigned or released
Claim.status becomes released when portions are released, or the claim moves to the new NGO when reassigned
Claim.portions_released is set to the unconfirmed portion count
error_handling: If the Pickup is not in failed status, the resolution is rejected and the admin sees that the assignment is no longer failed
If no outcome is selected, the resolution is not saved

business_rules.name: released_portions_return_to_donation_pool
business_rules.description: Portions released from a failed claim become available again on the donation so that other eligible NGOs can claim them, and only portions not yet confirmed as received are released.
triggers: Admin chooses release on a failed assignment
side_effects: Donation.portions_available increases by the released portion count
Donation.status returns to open for claims when portions remain available
Eligible NGOs see the released portions in their feed
error_handling: If the donation pickup-by time has passed, release is still recorded but the portions are not made available for new claims
If the claim already has a confirmed received quantity, only the unconfirmed remainder is released

business_rules.name: reassignment_must_not_over_allocate_portions_or_exceed_ngo_capacity
business_rules.description: Reassigning portions to another NGO is allowed only when that NGO's available capacity covers the reassigned quantity and the portions remain within the donation total, checked within a transaction.
triggers: Admin chooses reassign and selects a target NGO
side_effects: A new Claim is created or the existing Claim is reassigned to the target NGO with the reassigned portions
NgoCapacity.available_portions of the target NGO decreases by the reassigned count
Donation.portions_available is reduced accordingly
error_handling: If the target NGO lacks capacity or is unavailable, the reassignment is rejected and the admin is told the NGO cannot take the portions
If a concurrent claim consumes the portions, the reassignment fails and the admin can retry or release instead

business_rules.name: reassignment_must_respect_pickup_deadline
business_rules.description: Reassignment is permitted only while the donation pickup-by time has not passed, and otherwise the only valid outcome is release.
triggers: Admin selects reassign after the pickup-by time has been reached
side_effects: Reassign option is refused and the admin is directed to release the portions
error_handling: If reassign is attempted after the pickup-by time, it is blocked with an explanation and no state changes

business_rules.name: every_resolution_is_recorded_in_status_history
business_rules.description: Each resolution writes a StatusEvent that records the record changed, the prior and new status, the admin who acted, the outcome and the reason, so the donation detail page shows a complete history.
triggers: Admin confirms a reassign or release resolution
side_effects: A StatusEvent is appended for the Pickup and for the Claim that changed
The donation's status history on Donation Detail shows the admin resolution
Donor and NGO are notified of the outcome by email via Resend and push via OneSignal
error_handling: If the StatusEvent cannot be written, the resolution is rolled back so the history never disagrees with the state

business_rules.name: only_admin_can_resolve_failed_assignments
business_rules.description: Only users with the admin role may resolve a failed assignment, and the server enforces this regardless of what the interface shows.
triggers: Any user submits a resolution request for a failed assignment
side_effects: Non-admin attempts are rejected and logged as a denied action
error_handling: If the actor is not an admin, the request is refused and no Pickup or Claim state changes

validation_rules.description: Admin must choose either reassign or release before resolving a failed assignment.
validation_rules.error_message: Choose whether to reassign or release the portions.

validation_rules.description: When the action is reassign, a target NGO must be selected from NGOs with sufficient available capacity.
validation_rules.error_message: Select an NGO with available capacity to reassign these portions to.

validation_rules.description: The reassigned portion count is a whole number from 1 up to the unconfirmed portions on the claim, and not more than the target NGO's available capacity.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a whole number of portions between 1 and the unconfirmed portions that the selected NGO can take.

validation_rules.description: The resolution reason is required and between 5 and 300 characters so the status history explains the decision.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a short reason of 5 to 300 characters for this resolution.

name: CSR Sponsor Views Confirmed Impact
description: A CSR sponsor signs in to view campaign recognition and a transparent impact dashboard built only from confirmed deliveries.

steps.description: Sponsor signs in to view impact.

business_rules.name: sign_in_requires_approved_account
business_rules.description: A participant can sign in only when User.approval_status is approved; accounts move pending → approved, and pending accounts cannot sign in.
triggers: Sponsor submits email and password on the login page
Sponsor's account was created through sign-up and is awaiting admin approval
side_effects: On success, a signed-in session is started for the User
On a pending account, no session is started and the sponsor is told the account is awaiting admin approval
error_handling: Pending account: sign-in is refused with a message that approval is still pending
Approval status not found or unreadable: sign-in is refused and the sponsor is asked to try again later
Password does not match User.password_hash: sign-in is refused with the generic credential error

business_rules.name: suspended_user_cannot_sign_in
business_rules.description: A User whose approval_status has been changed to suspended by an admin is refused sign-in and any existing session is ended on its next server check.
triggers: Admin suspends a participant in Admin Operations
Suspended sponsor submits valid credentials on the login page
side_effects: No new session is created for the suspended User
An existing session for the User is invalidated when next checked by the server
error_handling: Valid credentials for a suspended account: sign-in is refused with a message that the account is suspended and to contact the administrator
Session check finds the account suspended: the sponsor is returned to the login page

business_rules.name: sponsor_session_limited_to_impact_view
business_rules.description: A User with role sponsor is signed in with sponsor permissions, which allow read-only access to the Sponsor Impact view and the Profile, and no write access to donations, claims, or capacity.
triggers: Sponsor signs in successfully and is routed to the sponsor landing page
side_effects: The sponsor lands on Sponsor Impact
Requests to donor, NGO, volunteer, or admin actions are refused for the sponsor session
error_handling: Sponsor requests a donor, NGO, volunteer, or admin action: the request is refused as not permitted for the role
User.role is missing or unrecognised: sign-in is refused and the account is flagged for admin review

business_rules.name: generic_credential_error_on_failed_login
business_rules.description: When the email is unknown or the password does not match, the sign-in response is the same generic message so that it does not reveal which accounts exist.
triggers: Sponsor submits an email that does not match any User
Sponsor submits a wrong password for an existing User
side_effects: No session is created
The sponsor stays on the login page with the typed email kept and the password cleared
error_handling: Unknown email and wrong password produce the same message
Repeated failures are recorded so that brute-force attempts can be slowed down

validation_rules.description: Email is required to sign in.
