validation_rules.error_message: Enter the email address you registered with.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address with an @ and a domain.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Password is required to sign in.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your password.

steps.description: Sponsor sees campaign recognition and the impact dashboard with confirmed portions, estimated waste avoided and illustrative costs, with assumptions such as 0.35 kg per portion labelled.

business_rules.name: only_ngo_confirmed_portions_counted
business_rules.description: The sponsor impact dashboard counts only portions that an NGO has confirmed as received, and excludes portions that are only claimed or reserved.
triggers: CSR sponsor opens the Sponsor Impact page
An NGO confirms a received quantity on a Claim
side_effects: ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions is recalculated as the sum of Claim.confirmed_quantity for claims whose status is confirmed
The dashboard shows the confirmed portion total to the sponsor
error_handling: If a Claim is in a reserved or claimed state without NGO confirmation, it is excluded from the totals without any error shown to the sponsor
If a Claim's confirmed_quantity is missing for a confirmed claim, it is excluded and the discrepancy is logged for admin review

business_rules.name: waste_avoided_estimated_from_confirmed_portions
business_rules.description: Estimated waste avoided is calculated as confirmed portions multiplied by the configurable assumption of 0.35 kg per portion, and is presented as an estimate.
triggers: CSR sponsor opens the Sponsor Impact page
ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions changes after an NGO confirmation
side_effects: ImpactSummary.waste_avoided_kg is set to confirmed_portions multiplied by kg_per_portion_assumption
The dashboard displays waste avoided as an estimated figure
error_handling: If the configured kg_per_portion_assumption is missing, the default of 0.35 kg is used and the default is flagged in the interface
If confirmed_portions is zero, waste_avoided_kg is shown as zero rather than a placeholder estimate

business_rules.name: assumptions_disclosed_beside_every_estimate
business_rules.description: Every estimated figure on the dashboard, including waste avoided and illustrative costs, is shown with its assumption labelled, including the 0.35 kg per portion value.
triggers: CSR sponsor views any estimated figure on the Sponsor Impact page
side_effects: The dashboard shows the assumption text (for example, 0.35 kg per portion) next to waste avoided
The dashboard shows a label stating that costs are illustrative beside the cost figure
error_handling: If an estimate is rendered without its assumption label, the page must not display that estimate and should show the assumption text instead

business_rules.name: illustrative_costs_never_presented_as_actuals
business_rules.description: Illustrative costs are derived from confirmed portions for demonstration only and are labelled as illustrative, with no payment or billing data involved.
triggers: CSR sponsor views the illustrative cost figure on the Sponsor Impact page
side_effects: ImpactSummary.illustrative_cost is recalculated from confirmed_portions using the illustrative rate
The dashboard displays the cost with an 'illustrative, not actual' label
error_handling: If the illustrative cost rate is not configured, the cost figure is hidden rather than shown with a guessed value

business_rules.name: sponsor_view_is_read_only
business_rules.description: A CSR sponsor can view campaign recognition and impact figures but cannot edit claims, confirmations, assumptions or any impact totals.
triggers: CSR sponsor attempts to access or change impact figures or assumptions
side_effects: Requests from a sponsor account that try to modify ImpactSummary or Claim records are refused
No record of the sponsor's view changes any stored value
error_handling: A write attempt from a sponsor user is rejected as unauthorised and the page remains unchanged
A sponsor opening an impact link without an active approved sponsor account is redirected to sign-in

business_rules.name: impact_summary_refreshes_on_confirmation
business_rules.description: The ImpactSummary is updated whenever an NGO confirms a received quantity, so the sponsor dashboard reflects the latest confirmed delivery.
triggers: NGO confirms the received quantity on a Claim
side_effects: Claim.status becomes confirmed
ImpactSummary totals (confirmed portions, waste avoided, illustrative cost) are updated
error_handling: If the summary update fails, the Claim confirmation is still saved and the summary is marked stale for later recalculation
A stale summary shows the time of its last successful update on the dashboard

business_rules.name: expired_reservations_excluded_from_impact
business_rules.description: Claims whose reservation has timed out without confirmation are released and never counted toward sponsor impact figures.
triggers: Reservation timeout elapses on a Claim without NGO confirmation
CSR sponsor opens the Sponsor Impact page
side_effects: Claim.status returns to released after the reservation timeout
Released portions are not included in ImpactSummary.confirmed_portions
error_handling: A claim whose timeout passed but was not yet processed is excluded from totals at read time

business_rules.name: empty_impact_state_shows_zero_not_estimates
business_rules.description: When no confirmed rescues exist, the dashboard shows zero confirmed portions and zero estimates with an explanatory message rather than placeholder or projected figures.
triggers: CSR sponsor opens the Sponsor Impact page before any confirmations exist
side_effects: Dashboard displays zero values and a message that no confirmed rescues are recorded yet
error_handling: If the impact query fails, the dashboard shows an unavailable message instead of zeros

business_rules.name: synthetic_data_disclosed_on_dashboard
business_rules.description: The Sponsor Impact page states that all people, organisations, addresses and figures are synthetic hackathon data.
triggers: CSR sponsor views the Sponsor Impact page
side_effects: A synthetic data notice is displayed on the dashboard
error_handling: If the notice setting is unavailable, the page still displays the default synthetic data notice

name: Profile Update and Sign-Out
description: A participant updates their name, email or password from the profile page and then signs out.

steps.description: Participant opens the profile and sees their current name and email.

business_rules.name: profile_shows_only_signed_in_users_own_record
business_rules.description: A participant sees only their own name and email on the profile, and no other user's details are ever shown.
triggers: Participant opens the Profile page
side_effects: The profile page displays the current User.name and User.email of the signed-in participant
No record is changed
error_handling: If no participant is signed in, the visitor is sent to the Login page instead of seeing any profile data
If the User record cannot be loaded, the page shows a plain message that the profile is unavailable and offers a retry

business_rules.name: profile_displays_current_account_details_as_stored
business_rules.description: The name and email shown on the profile are the values currently stored on the User record, so the participant sees what the platform will use for notifications and sign-in.
triggers: Participant opens the Profile page
side_effects: The participant sees the stored User.name and User.email, which are the same values used for account emails
error_handling: If User.name is empty, the page shows a placeholder such as 'Name not set' rather than a blank field

steps.description: Participant changes name, email or password and saves the changes.

business_rules.name: profile_changes_persist_to_user_record
business_rules.description: A participant's changed name, email or password is saved to their User record only when they submit the profile form, and the record is left unchanged if the save fails.
triggers: Participant edits name, email or password on the Profile page and taps save
side_effects: User.name is replaced with the new name when provided
User.email is replaced with the new email when provided
User.password_hash is replaced with a hash of the new password when provided
User.updated_at is set to the save time
the participant sees a confirmation that their profile was saved
error_handling: If any field fails validation, none of the changes are saved and the failing fields are flagged
If the save fails on the server, the User record keeps its previous values and the participant is asked to try again

business_rules.name: email_must_be_unique_across_users
business_rules.description: A new email address must not match the email of any other User, compared without regard to letter case.
triggers: Participant saves a changed email on the Profile page
side_effects: User.email is updated only when no other User holds that address
error_handling: If another User already has the email, the save is rejected and the participant is told the address is already in use
If the participant submits their current email unchanged, no uniqueness error is raised

business_rules.name: password_change_requires_current_password
business_rules.description: A new password is accepted only when the participant first proves knowledge of their current password, and the new password must be different from the current one.
triggers: Participant enters a new password on the Profile page and saves
side_effects: User.password_hash is replaced with a hash of the new password only when the current password matches
the participant is emailed through Resend that their password was changed
error_handling: If the current password does not match, the change is rejected and no password is stored
If the new password equals the current password, the save is rejected and the participant is asked to choose a different one

business_rules.name: password_change_ends_other_sessions
business_rules.description: After a password change, all existing sessions for that User except the one making the change are ended.
triggers: Participant's password is successfully changed on the Profile page
side_effects: any other signed-in device for that User must sign in again with the new password
error_handling: If session invalidation fails, the password change still stands and the failure is logged for follow-up

business_rules.name: profile_edit_cannot_change_role_or_approval
business_rules.description: Name, email and password edits never alter a User's role or approval status, which only an admin can change, so a participant's permissions stay as approved.
triggers: Participant saves any change on the Profile page
side_effects: User.role and User.approval_status keep their existing values after every profile save
error_handling: Any attempt to submit a role or approval status from the profile form is ignored and the save proceeds with the allowed fields only

business_rules.name: email_change_notifies_previous_address
business_rules.description: When a participant's email changes, a notification is sent to the previous address through Resend so the owner can spot an unauthorised change.
triggers: Participant's email is successfully changed on the Profile page
side_effects: the previous email address receives a notice that the account email was changed
the change is recorded against the User with its timestamp
error_handling: If the Resend send fails, the email change still stands and the notice is retried or logged for follow-up

validation_rules.description: Name is required and must not be blank when saving the profile.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your name.

validation_rules.description: Name is between 2 and 80 characters after trimming surrounding spaces.
validation_rules.error_message: Name must be between 2 and 80 characters.

validation_rules.description: Email is required and must not be blank when saving the profile.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter your email address.

validation_rules.description: Email must be a well-formed address with a local part, an @ symbol and a domain containing a dot.
validation_rules.error_message: Please enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.

validation_rules.description: Email must not already belong to another User, compared without regard to letter case.
validation_rules.error_message: This email address is already used by another account.

validation_rules.description: Current password is required whenever a new password is entered.
validation_rules.error_message: Enter your current password to set a new one.

validation_rules.description: New password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must be at least 8 characters.

validation_rules.description: New password must contain at least one letter and at least one number.
validation_rules.error_message: Password must include at least one letter and one number.

validation_rules.description: Password confirmation must exactly match the new password.
validation_rules.error_message: The passwords do not match.

steps.description: Participant signs out and returns to the role entry page.

business_rules.name: sign_out_ends_user_session
business_rules.description: When a participant signs out, their active session is ended on the server so the session can no longer act on their behalf (signed in → signed out).
triggers: Participant taps the sign-out action on the Profile page
side_effects: User.session_token is cleared or revoked on the server
User.last_signed_out_at is set to the current time
The browser's session credential is removed so the person is no longer recognised as signed in
error_handling: If the session has already expired or been revoked, sign-out still completes and the person is taken to the role entry page
If the server cannot revoke the session, the local credential is still cleared so the device is signed out, and the failure is logged for follow-up
A request to sign out without a valid session is treated as already signed out and does not raise an error to the user

business_rules.name: signed_out_user_loses_protected_page_access
business_rules.description: After sign-out, protected pages such as the Profile, Donor Dashboard, NGO Feed, Volunteer Tasks and Admin Operations are no longer accessible until the person signs in again (signed in → signed out → access denied).
triggers: Participant signs out and then navigates to or reloads a protected page
A browser back-navigation reaches a protected page after sign-out
side_effects: The protected page is not shown and the person is sent to the role entry page
No participant data from the protected page is returned to the signed-out browser
error_handling: If a cached protected page is shown from history, the server-side check still blocks any data and redirects to the role entry page
If the session check fails for any reason, the person is treated as signed out rather than granted access

business_rules.name: sign_out_does_not_change_open_work
business_rules.description: Signing out does not alter a participant's donations, claims, pickups or handover confirmations, which remain in their current status for other participants and admins to see (in progress → in progress).
triggers: Participant signs out while they have a donation, claim, pickup or receipt in progress
side_effects: No Donation, Claim or Pickup status is changed by the sign-out
No StatusEvent is created for the sign-out itself
Pending reservation timeouts continue to run as configured and release unconfirmed portions on schedule
The restaurant, NGO or volunteer's open work remains visible to the other parties involved
error_handling: If a claim reservation is still active when the person signs out, it is left for the reservation timeout to release rather than being released by sign-out
If an in-progress handover cannot be completed by the signed-out person, admins can resolve it through Admin Operations
